title: Families search for loved ones after deadly Ceuta crossings
english: Families in northern Morocco are desperately looking for relatives following a tragic attempt to cross into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. At least 72 people lost their lives during the dangerous journey, leaving others trapped in the territory. The high death toll has sparked significant anti-migrant protests across Spain.
amharic: በሰሜን ሞሮኮ የሚገኙ ቤተሰቦች ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ ለመሻገር በተደረገ አደገኛ ሙከራ የጠፉባቸውን ወገኖቻቸውን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየፈለጉ ነው። በዚህ አደጋ ቢያንስ 72 ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን ያጡ ሲሆን፣ የተወሰኑ ስደተኞች አሁንም በተጠቀሰው ግዛት ውስጥ ተይዘዋል። የሞቱት ሰዎች ቁጥር ከፍተኛ መሆኑ በስፔን ውስጥ የፀረ-ስደተኞች ተቃውሞ እንዲቀሰቀስ ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Maatiiwwan kaaba Morookoo keessa jiraatan, gara naannoo Sipeen kan taate Si'utaatti ce'uuf yaalii taasifameen booda firoottan isaanii barbaadaa jiru. Tarsiimoo balaa qabu kanaan lubbuun namoota 72 ol darbeera, garuu godaantonni tokko tokko amma iyyuu naannichatti cufamanii hafan. Balaa cimaa kanaan walqabatee, biyya Sipeen keessatti mormiin godaantotaa irratti xiyyeeffatu ka'eera.

title: Heatwave in Gaza compounds Palestinian suffering
english: Displaced Palestinians in Gaza are facing a severe heatwave while living in makeshift plastic shelters. These extreme temperatures have significantly worsened their already dire humanitarian conditions. Families are struggling to find ways to keep cool as they lack basic resources to manage the dangerous weather.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ተፈናቃይ ፍልስጤማውያን በፕላስቲክ መጠለያዎች ውስጥ እየኖሩ ከፍተኛ የሙቀት ማዕበል እያጋጠማቸው ነው። ይህ አስከፊ የአየር ሁኔታ አስቀድሞ በችግር ላይ ለሚገኙት ቤተሰቦች ህይወት እጅግ አሳሳቢ ሆኗል። አብዛኛዎቹ ተጎጂዎች ራሳቸውን ከሙቀት ለመከላከል የሚያስችል በቂ መገልገያ የላቸውም።
oromo: Namoonni Gaza keessatti buqqa'an dunkaana pilaastikii ta'e keessa jiraachaa jiran ho'a cimaa keessa darbanii jiru. Ho'i kun haala jireenyaa isaanii isa amma iyyuu ulfaataa ta'e caalaatti hammaddeesseera. Maatiin hedduun ho'a kana ofirraa ittisuuf meeshaa barbaachisaa ta'e waan hin qabneef rakkina guddaa keessa jiru.

title: People flee as rain triggers landslide in India’s Kerala
english: Heavy rainfall in India’s Kerala state caused a hillside to collapse onto a main highway, forcing nearby residents to evacuate the area. Although officials had previously restricted access to the road due to safety concerns, locals argue that extensive excavation of the hills over the years made the slope dangerously unstable. No injuries were reported as people were able to flee to safety before the slide occurred.
amharic: በህንድ ኬረላ ግዛት የጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ የተራራ ክፍል ወደ ዋናው አውራ ጎዳና እንዲፈርስ አድርጓል። ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን ቀድመው ዘግተውት የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች በተደጋጋሚ የሚከናወነው የተራራ መቆራረጥ መሬቱን አላላላው ሲሉ ይወቅሳሉ። ሰዎችም የጉዳቱን አደጋ በመረዳት አስቀድመው አካባቢውን በመልቀቃቸው የሰው ህይወት አልጠፋም።
oromo: Bokkaa cimaa Hindii, naannoo Keeralaa keessatti roobeen lafti ishee gaaraa tokko gara karaa guddichaatti akka gadi cabu taasiseera. Mootummaan balaa duraa hubatee daandicha cufatee ture; ta'us, jiraattonni yeroo dheeraaf gaarreen kutaachaa turuun lafa sana laaffiseera jedhu. Namoonni balaa kana dura of eeggannoo gochuun bakkeewwan irraa baqachuu danda'aniiru.

title: Massive Attack says members held after pro-Palestine display in Singapore
english: Members of the British band Massive Attack were detained and questioned by Singaporean police after displaying a Palestinian flag during their concert. Authorities justified the action by claiming the display violated local regulations regarding public symbols and risked social harmony. Consequently, two band members received official warnings and have been banned from returning to Singapore.
amharic: የብሪታንያው የሙዚቃ ቡድን ማሲቭ አታክ አባላት በሲንጋፖር ባደረጉት ኮንሰርት ወቅት የፍልስጤምን ባንዲራ በማውለብለባቸው በፖሊስ ተይዘው ምርመራ ተደርጎባቸዋል። የሲንጋፖር ባለስልጣናት ይህ ድርጊት የሀገሪቱን ህግ የሚጥስ እና ማህበራዊ መግባባትን የሚጎዳ ነው በማለት ተችተውታል። በዚህም ምክንያት የቡድኑ ሁለት አባላት ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰጣቸው ሲሆን ወደ ሀገሪቱ እንዳይመለሱም ታግደዋል።
oromo: miseensonni garee muuziqaa Massive Attack jedhamu kan biyya Britaniyaa, konsertii Singapooriitti sagantaa isaanii irratti alaabaa Filisxeem baasuun isaanii hordofee poolisiin qabamanii gaaffiif dhiyaataniiru. Aangeyyoonni Singaappoor gochi kun seera biyyattii cabsuufi walitti dhufeenya hawaasaa irratti miidha geessisuu danda'a jedhaniiru. Kanaan walqabatee, miseensonni garee kanaa lama akeekkachiisa cimaa argataniiru akkasumas gara Singaappoor akka hin deebine dhorkamaniiru.

title: Why genocide keeps repeating in Sudan
english: The city of el-Obeid in Sudan is facing a severe humanitarian crisis as it becomes the latest target in the ongoing war between the national army and the Rapid Support Forces. Despite the United Nations labeling previous attacks in Darfur as genocide, the lack of decisive international intervention has allowed the violence to continue spreading. As the conflict intensifies, residents are left trapped without essential services and face an increasingly desperate future.
amharic: የሱዳኗ ኤል-ኦቤይድ ከተማ በአገሪቱ ጦር እና በፍጥነት ደጋፊ ኃይሎች መካከል በሚደረገው ጦርነት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በዳርፉር የተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶችን የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ብሎ ቢፈርስም፣ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ እርምጃ ባለመውሰዱ ግጭቱ እየተባባሰ ቀጥሏል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የከተማዋ ነዋሪዎች መሠረታዊ አገልግሎት ሳያገኙ ወጥመድ ውስጥ በመውደቃቸው ለከፍተኛ ስቃይ ተዳርገዋል።
oromo: Magaalaan Suddaan, el-Obeid, waraana mootummaa fi garee RSF gidduutti adeemsifamaa jiruun rakkoo namoomaa cimaa keessa seentee jirti. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii haleellaa Darfuuritti raawwatame 'fixiinsa sanyii' jechuun moggaasee kan ture ta'us, addunyaan tarkaanfii cimaa waan hin fudhanneef waraanni kun babal'achaa jira. Yeroo ammaa jiraattonni magaalaatii tajaajila barbaachisaa ta'e dhabuun akkasumas bakka itti baqatan dhabuun lubbuun isaanii balaa cimaa keessa jira.

title: German court rules comparing Israel to Nazi Germany constitutes 'protected speech'
english: A German court has overturned a woman's conviction for sharing social media posts that compared Israel's actions in Gaza to Nazi Germany. The judges ruled that these images were protected political speech rather than expressions of hate, as the intent was to criticize state violence rather than promote Nazi ideology. This decision confirms that using controversial symbols to protest against military actions does not automatically constitute a crime in Germany.
amharic: የጀርመን ፍርድ ቤት እስራኤል በጋዛ የምትወስደውን እርምጃ ከናዚ ጀርመን ጋር በማነፃፀር ማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ጽሁፎችን የለጠፈች ሴት የተላለፈባትን የቅጣት ውሳኔ ሽሯል። ፍርድ ቤቱ የሴትየዋ ተግባር ጥላቻን የሚቀሰቅስ ሳይሆን የመንግስትን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ለመተቸት የተደረገ የፖለቲካ አገላለጽ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። በዚህም መሰረት በጀርመን ህግ ውስጥ ተከራካሪ ምልክቶችን ለፖለቲካዊ ትችት መጠቀም እንደ ወንጀል እንደማይቆጠር ውሳኔው አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Mana murtii Jarmanii tokko dubartii tokko irratti murtoo kanaan dura darbe kan jijjiire yoo ta'u, kunis ibsa miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti Israelii fi Naazii Jarmanii wal bira qabdee ilaalte irratti kan hundaa'edha. Abbootiin seeraa, gochi kun yaada siyaasaa fi balaaleffannaa gocha waraanaa irratti xiyyeeffate malee, yaada jibbaa kan babal'isu miti jechuun murteessaniiru. Murteen kun, mallattoowwan mormii fayyadamuun yoo gocha waraanaa balaaleffachuuf ta'e, akka yakkaatti akka hin ilaalamne ifa godheera.

title: Israel destroys West Bank wells serving Palestinian herders
english: Israeli forces recently demolished three essential water wells in the Ras al-Ahmar area of the occupied West Bank. This action has left local Palestinian farming and herding families without a reliable source of water for their households, crops, and livestock. Many residents now fear they may be forced to abandon their ancestral lands because they cannot sustain their livelihoods without access to water.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ራስ አል-አህማር አካባቢ የሚገኙ ሶስት ዋና ዋና የውሃ ጉድጓዶችን አውድመዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በአካባቢው የሚኖሩ የፍልስጤም አርሶ አደሮች እና እረኞች ለቤተሰባቸው፣ ለሰብላቸው እና ለእንስሳቶቻቸው የሚያስፈልገውን ውሃ እንዳያገኙ አድርጓቸዋል። ነዋሪዎቹ የውሃ አቅርቦት ከሌለ የኑሮ ሁኔታቸውን መቀጠል ስለማይችሉ መኖሪያቸውን ለቀው ለመሰደድ በመገደድ ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el naannoo Raas al-Ahmaar kan iddoo Qileensaa (West Bank) jiru keessatti boollee bishaanii sadan gurguddoo ta'an barbadeessaniiru. Gochi kun maatiiwwan warra Qilleensa-jireessaa fi qonnaan bulaa ta'an kanneen bishaan ga'aan akka hin arganne taasiseera. Namoonni naannichaa bishaan dhabuun jireenya isaanii fi horsiisa beeyladoota isaanii waan miidhuuf, bakkeewwan kanneen gadhiisanii ba'uuf dirqama keessa akka jiran yaaddoo qabu.

title: Israeli court blocks Ben Gvir crocodile moat plan for prisons holding Palestinians
english: An Israeli court has issued a temporary injunction to halt a proposal by Minister Itamar Ben Gvir to surround Palestinian prisons with moats containing crocodiles. The plan, which had already seen excavation work begin at Ketziot Prison, was challenged by an animal welfare organization concerned about the potential mistreatment of the animals and risks to staff safety. Consequently, the government must pause the initiative while the legal case is reviewed.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፍርድ ቤት የሀገሪቱ የብሔራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር ፍልስጤማውያን እስረኞች በሚገኙባቸው እስር ቤቶች ዙሪያ አዞዎች የሚኖሩባቸው ቦዮችን ለመቆፈር ያቀዱትን እቅድ አግዷል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የእንስሳት መብት ተሟጋች ቡድን በእንስሳቱ ላይ የሚደርሰውን እንግልት እና ለሰራተኞች ደህንነት ያለውን ስጋት በመጥቀስ ክስ ካቀረቡ በኋላ ነው። በዚህም መሰረት በኬትዚዮት እስር ቤት የተጀመረው የቦይ ቁፋሮ ስራ ለጊዜው ቆሟል።
oromo: Mana murtii Israa'el tokko, ministirri nageenyaa Itamar Ben Gvir manneen hidhaa warra Falasxiin jiranitti naannoo isaa boollee uumee bineensa 'crocodiles' keessatti gurguruuf karoorfate dhorgee jira. Karoorri kun erga lafa qotamuu jalqabee booda, gareen mirga bineensotaa falmu tokko, bineensonni kun miidhamuu fi hojjettoonni manneen hidhaas balaaf saaxilamuu danda'u jedhanii himata erga dhiyeessanii booda dhaabateera. Kanaanis, hojiin qotii mana hidhaa Ketziot irratti jalqabamee turef yeroof akka dhaabbatu godhameera.

title: How Lamine Yamal became a symbol of Spain’s identity debate
english: Lamine Yamal, the 19-year-old star who recently helped Spain win the World Cup, has become a central figure in a heated debate regarding Spanish identity. As a player with Moroccan and Equatorial Guinean roots who openly practices Islam, his public gestures of faith have triggered both support and intense online hostility. While many celebrate him as a representative of modern, multicultural Spain, far-right critics have used his background to question his place in the national team.
amharic: ስፔን የዓለም ዋንጫን እንድታሸንፍ የረዳው የ19 ዓመቱ ኮከብ ላሚን ያማል፣ በስፔን ብሔራዊ ማንነት ላይ በተነሳው ክርክር ማዕከል ውስጥ ገብቷል። ሞሮኳዊ እና ኢኳቶሪያል ጊኒያዊ የዘር ግንድ ያለው እና እስልምና እምነት ተከታይ የሆነው ይህ ተጫዋች፣ በሜዳ ላይ የሚያሳያቸው የእምነት መግለጫዎች የተለያዩ አስተያየቶችን አስከትለዋል። ብዙዎች እሱን እንደ ዘመናዊ እና የተለያዩ ባህሎች ተዋህደው የሚታዩባት ስፔን ምልክት አድርገው ሲመለከቱት፣ አንዳንድ ጽንፈኛ ቡድኖች ግን የእሱን ማንነት በመቃወም በብሔራዊ ቡድኑ ውስጥ ቦታ እንደሌለው በመግለጽ ጥቃት እየሰነዘሩበት ይገኛል።

Dhalootaan biyya Marookoo fi Ekwatoriyaal Giinii irraa ta'uun isaa fi amantii Islaamaa hordofuu isaa ifatti argisiisuun isaa, gariin akka gaariitti akka ilaalamu yoo taasisu, warra sirreeffamoota mirgaa irratti qabatan tokko tokko biratti garuu mormii fi jibbiinsaan akka ilaalamu godhee jira. Namoonni hedduun Ispeen ammayyaa fi gosa adda addaa of keessatti hammattu jedhanii yoo isa faarsan, gareen mirgaa (far-right) garuu eenyummaa isaa fi bakka inni garee biyyattii keessatti qabu gaaffii keessa galchuudhaan jibbiinsa irratti aggaamanii jiru.

title: Saudi tankers turn away from Gulf of Aden
english: Six Saudi Arabian oil tankers have diverted their routes away from the Gulf of Aden to avoid potential attacks from Houthi rebels. Instead of using the direct Red Sea path, the empty ships are traveling together around the southern coast of Africa. This decision follows specific warnings from the Houthis targeting Saudi vessels in the region.

oromo: Markaboonni boba'aa Sa'udii jahan, garee Hutiirraa miidhaan isaanirra ga'uu waan maluuf, daandii itti imalaa isaanii jijjiirataniiru. Markaboonni kunneen daandii gabaabaa galaana diimaa fayyadamuu dhiisanii, qarqara kibba Afrikaatiin imalaa jiru. Murtii kana kan fudhatan erga gareen Hutiin dooniiwwan Sa'udii irratti xiyyeeffachuuf doorsisa godhee boodadha.

title: Aung San Suu Kyi appears healthy in first confirmed outside contact for 2.5 years
english: Detained Myanmar leader Aung San Suu Kyi has met with the Red Cross for the first time in over two years, providing the public with proof of her safety. While the military government released photos showing her in good health, no specific information regarding her well-being or the content of the meeting was disclosed. Her son described this as a positive initial step in an ongoing campaign for her release.
amharic: የማይንማርዋ መሪ አውንግ ሳን ሱ ቺ ከአራት ዓመታት ወዲህ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ከዓለም አቀፉ የቀይ መስቀል ልዑካን ጋር ተገናኝተዋል። ወታደራዊ መንግሥቱ ይፋ ባደረገው ፎቶግራፍ መሪዋ በጤናማ ሁኔታ ላይ እንደሚገኙ ለማየት ተችሏል፤ ሆኖም ስለጤንነታቸው ዝርዝር መረጃ አልተሰጠም። ልጃቸው ይህንን እድገት እንደ በጎ ጅምር የቆጠሩት ሲሆን ለእናታቸው መፈታት የሚደረገው ጥረት መቀጠል እንዳለበት አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hoggantuun biyya Maaynamaar Aung San Suuk Chi waggaa lamaa ol booda yeroo jalqabaaf gargaarsa qaama sadarkaa addunyaatti argamu waliin walarguun isaanii mirkanaa'eera. Mootummaan waraanaa suuraa isaan fayyaa ta'uu isaanii argisiisu gadhiisus, waa'ee haala isaanii kan ibsame hin jiru. Ilmi isaanii tarkaanfichi kan nama gammachiisu ta'uu ibsuun, garuu gara fuulduraatti bilisa bahuu isaaniif tattaaffiin godhamu akka itti fufu gaafataniiru.

title: Two workers killed in blast after re-entering quake-hit Japan mall on boss' order
english: Two employees died in a shopping mall explosion in Japan after their manager ordered them to re-enter the quake-damaged building to secure cash. The company, Habita, has publicly apologized for the inappropriate decision that led to the loss of these lives. Family members and officials confirmed that the workers were performing this task when the blast occurred following a magnitude 6.8 earthquake.
amharic: በጃፓን የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በተመታ የገበያ ማዕከል ውስጥ በከፍተኛ ኃላፊ ትዕዛዝ ገንዘብ ለመሰብሰብ ወደ ውስጥ የገቡ ሁለት ሠራተኞች በደረሰ ፍንዳታ ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የሠራተኞቹ ቀጣሪ ድርጅት የሆነው ሀቢታ፣ ለሠራተኞቹ ሞት ምክንያት የሆነውን ተገቢ ያልሆነ ውሳኔ በይፋ ይቅርታ ጠይቋል። የሟቾች ቤተሰቦች እና የኩባንያው ኃላፊዎች እንደሚያረጋግጡት፣ አደጋው የተከሰተው በ6.8 ማግኒትዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በተከተለው ፍንዳታ ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Jaappaan keessatti hojjettoonni lama mana gabaa kirkira lafaatiin miidhame keessa jiru akka qabeenya (maallaqa) walitti qaban hogganaan isaanii erga ajajanii booda, bakka sanatti dhohee lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Dhaabbanni hojii isaanis gocha kanaaf gadda guddaa ibsuun dhiifama gaafateera. Hojjettoonni kunneen kirkira lafaa hanga 6.8 gahu erga mudatee booda erga gara mana gabaa sanatti deebi'anii booda dhohiinsi kun isaanitti dhufe.

title: US and Japan take action to prop up yen in rare joint move
english: The United States and Japan have launched a rare joint effort to stabilize the Japanese yen after it dropped to a 40-year low. By coordinating their market actions, the two nations aim to discourage speculators and prevent the currency's decline from negatively affecting the global economy. Officials have signaled that they are prepared to continue these interventions periodically to ensure financial stability.
amharic: የጃፓን የን ምንዛሬ በ40 ዓመታት ውስጥ ዝቅተኛ ደረጃ ላይ በመድረሱ፣ አሜሪካ እና ጃፓን ምንዛሬውን ለማረጋጋት በጋራ ጣልቃ ገብተዋል። ሁለቱ አገራት ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰዱት በገበያ ላይ የሚስተዋለውን የዋጋ መዋዠቅ ለመቆጣጠር እና በዓለም አቀፍ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ሊደርስ የሚችለውን ተፅዕኖ ለመከላከል ነው። ባለሥልጣናቱ የገበያ መረጋጋትን ለመጠበቅ ሲባል ተመሳሳይ የጋራ እርምጃዎችን በድጋሚ ለመውሰድ ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Maallaqni Yeenii (Yen) biyya Jaappaan gabaa keessatti waggoota 40 keessatti gara sadarkaa gad-aanaa isaatti waan kufeef, Ameerikaan fi Jaappaan qindoominaan gargaaruuf murteessaniiru. Gochi kun kan raawwatame gabaa keessatti tilmaama dogoggoraa fi rakkoo dinagdee addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisu ittisuufi. Biyyoonni kun lamaan yoo barbaachise gara fuulduraattis qindoominaan gabaa keessa seenuun maallaqicha tasgabbeessuuf qophii ta'uu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Ukraine strikes Russia’s biggest retailer again
english: Ukraine has launched another long-range drone attack targeting a warehouse owned by Wildberries, Russia's largest e-commerce retailer. Kyiv officials state that the facility was hit because the company is used to store components for Russian military drones. This strike is part of ongoing efforts by Ukraine to disrupt Russian supply chains and military logistics.
amharic: ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ትልቁ የኢ-ኮሜርስ ኩባንያ ዋይልድቤሪስ መጋዘን ላይ የረጅም ርቀት ድሮን ጥቃት አድርሳለች። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት፣ ኩባንያው ለሩሲያ ወታደራዊ ድሮኖች የሚውሉ መለዋወጫዎችን ለማከማቻነት ይጠቀሙበት ነበር። ይህ ጥቃት ዩክሬን የሩሲያን ወታደራዊ አቅርቦት ሰንሰለት ለማስተጓጎል የምታደርገው ጥረት አካል ነው።
oromo: Yukireen dirree gurgurtaa meeshaalee kan ta'e kan Raashiyaa Wildberries irraatti haleellaa xiyyaara malee (drone) gaggeessiteetti. Bulchiinsi Yukireen akka jedhutti, iddoon kun meeshaalee waraana Raashiyaa ittiin hojjetaman kuusuuf kan oolu waan ta'eef haleellichi irratti xiyyeeffate. Haleellaan kun carraaqqii Yukireen gargaarsa waraanaa Raashiyaa gufachiisuuf taasiftu keessaa tokko.

title: Israel defies Trump’s peace plan as it escalates deadly attacks on Gaza
english: Israel has intensified its military bombardment of the Gaza Strip, ignoring a US-backed ceasefire plan that Hamas had already agreed to. Despite recent diplomatic efforts led by Donald Trump to stabilize the region, Israeli forces have continued lethal attacks that have killed dozens of civilians over the weekend. This ongoing military escalation threatens the proposed peace roadmap and worsens the humanitarian crisis, leaving observers concerned that the deal may ultimately collapse.
amharic: እስራኤል ሀማስ የተቀበለውን በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የተዘጋጀውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ችላ በማለት በጋዛ ላይ የሚያደርሰውን የቦምብ ጥቃት አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች። ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ክልሉን ለማረጋጋት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶችን ቢያደርጉም፣ እስራኤል በሳምንቱ መጨረሻ በፈጸመችው ጥቃት በርካታ ንፁሀን ዜጎች ተገድለዋል። ይህ የቀጠለው ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የሰላም ስምምነቱን አደጋ ላይ ከመጣሉም በላይ በጋዛ ያለውን የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ይበልጥ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Israa'el gamtaan Hamas waliigaltee gargaarsa Ameerikaatiin qophaa'e fi hojiirra ooluu qabu tuffachuudhaan, haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi meeshaa waraanaa Gaza irratti gaggeessitu jabeessiteetti. Preezdaant Donald Traamp nagaa buusuuf carraaqqii taasisaa jiranis, haleellaa Israa'el torban dhumaa kana gaggeessiteen namoonni hedduun ajjeefamaniiru. Waraanni kun fuulduratti kaayyoo nagaa buusuu danquudhaan, haala hamaa namoomaa fi gidiraa Gaza keessa jiru daran kan hammaachisu ta'uu isaa hoggantoonni fi xiinxaltoonni himu.

title: US cricket player Reddy receives eight-year ban for match-fixing
english: The International Cricket Council has imposed an eight-year ban on US player Akhilesh Reddy for match-fixing violations. The 26-year-old was found guilty of attempting to manipulate match outcomes, pressuring another athlete to engage in corruption, and destroying digital evidence. This suspension is retroactive to November 2025.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፍ የክሪኬት ምክር ቤት የአሜሪካው ተጫዋች አኪሌሽ ሬዲ በጨዋታ ማጭበርበር ወንጀል ለስምንት ዓመታት ከስፖርቱ አግዶታል። የ26 ዓመቱ ተጫዋች የጨዋታ ውጤቶችን ለማዛባት መሞከሩ፣ ሌላ ተጫዋች በሙስና ውስጥ እንዲሳተፍ ግፊት ማድረጉ እና ማስረጃዎችን ማጥፋቱ ተረጋግጧል። እገዳው ከህዳር 2025 ጀምሮ ተግባራዊ ይሆናል።
oromo: Koree Kireeketii Addunyaa taphataa Ameerikaa Akhilesh Reddy irratti, tapha sobaa qopheesse jechuun waggaa saddeetiif dhorkaa irratti dabarseera. Dargaggeessi umuriinsaa 26 ta'e kun, bu'aa taphaa jijjiiruuf yaaluu, taphataa biroo yakka kana keessatti hirmaachisuuf dirqisiisuu, akkasumas ragaa harka isaa jiru balleessuun yakkaamaa ta'ee argameera. Dhorkaan kunis baatii Sadaasaa bara 2025 irraa kaasee kan hojiirra oolu ta'a.

title: North Koreans flood new ‘tourist zone’ beach amid heatwave
english: North Korean state media recently showcased footage of residents visiting a new luxury beach resort. The government is promoting this development as a major tourist destination. The video highlighted crowds of people enjoying the seaside during a period of intense heat.
amharic: የሰሜን ኮሪያ የመንግስት ሚዲያ በቅርቡ ነዋሪዎች በአዲሱ የቅንጦት የባህር ዳርቻ መዝናኛ ቦታ ሲዝናኑ የሚያሳይ ምስል አሰራጭቷል። መንግስት ይህንን ስፍራ እንደ ዋና የቱሪዝም መዳረሻ እያስተዋወቀ ይገኛል። በቪዲዮው ላይም በሙቀት ማዕበል ወቅት ብዙ ህዝብ በባህር ዳርቻው ሲዝናና ይታያል።
oromo: Miidiyaan mootummaa Kooriyaa Kaabaa dhuma torban darbe keessa ummanni bakka boqonnaa qophaa’e haaraa keessatti yeroo dabarsaa jiran agarsiiseera. Mootummaan naannoo kana bakka hawwata tuurizimii guddaa ta'ee akka fudhatamuuf kakaasaa jira. Viidiyichi guyyoota ho’i cimaan ture kana keessa namoonni hedduun qarqara galaanaatti fayyadamoo ta’uu isaanii mul’isa.

title: First moments of Egypt earthquake caught during livestream
english: A 5.4 magnitude earthquake recently struck near the city of Suez in Egypt, with tremors reaching as far as Gaza. The event was unexpectedly captured on video while a content creator was hosting a live broadcast. Fortunately, there have been no reports of injuries or deaths resulting from the earthquake.
amharic: በቅርቡ በግብፅ የሱዌዝ ከተማ አቅራቢያ የ5.4 ማግኒትዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ተከስቷል፣ ይህም መንቀጥቀጡ እስከ ጋዛ ድረስ ተሰምቷል። ይህ ክስተት አንድ የይዘት ፈጣሪ የቀጥታ ስርጭት በሚያስተላልፍበት ወቅት በቪዲዮ ተቀርጿል። እንደ እድል ሆኖ፣ ከመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ ጋር በተያያዘ ምንም አይነት ጉዳት ወይም ሞት አልተዘገበም።
oromo: Sadaasa kana keessa, biyya Gibxi, magaalaa Suwezitti diigamni lafaa guddaan hanga 5.4 ga'u mudateera. Sochiin lafaa kun hanga Gaazaatti kan dhaga'ame yoo ta'u, nama viidiyoowwan qopheessu tokko irratti utuu inni qilleensa irra jiruu qabameera. Gammachuu qaba, rakkoon lubbuu ykn miidhaan qaamaa namoota irra ga'e hin jiru.

title: 'They want to make us leave': Israel destroys West Bank wells serving Palestinian herders
english: Israeli forces recently destroyed three primary water wells in the Ras al-Ahmar community of the West Bank, severely impacting over 600 Palestinians. These wells were essential for drinking, agriculture, and livestock, and their loss has forced residents to pay for expensive water shipments that are frequently blocked at checkpoints. The villagers believe this action is part of an ongoing effort to pressure them into abandoning their ancestral land.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በቅርቡ በምዕራብ ባንክ በምትገኘው ራስ አል-አህማር ማህበረሰብ የሚገኙ ሶስት ዋና ዋና የውሃ ጉድጓዶችን አውድመዋል፤ ይህም ከ600 በላይ ለሚሆኑ ፍልስጤማውያን ከፍተኛ ችግር ፈጥሯል። እነዚህ ጉድጓዶች ለጠጪነት፣ ለግብርና እና ለእንስሳት እርባታ ወሳኝ የነበሩ ሲሆን፣ መጥፋታቸው ነዋሪዎቹን ውድ የሆነ ውሃ ከሌላ ቦታ እንዲያስመጡ አስገድዷቸዋል። የጉድጓዶቹ መውደም የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ከመሬታቸው እንዲለቁ ለማስገደድ የታቀደ አካሄድ እንደሆነ ነዋሪዎቹ ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el dhiheenya kana naannoo baanki dhihaa, ganda Raas al-Ahmar keessatti boolla bishaanii sadii kanneen namoota 600 ol ta'aniif tajaajilaa turan barbadeessaniiru. Boollonni kun dhugaatii, qonnaa fi horsiisa beeyiladaaf kanneen murteessoo turan yoo ta'u, barbadaa'uun isaanii jiraattonni bishaan miilaan fagoorraa gatii guddaan akka bitatan dirqisiiseera. Jiraattonni, tarkaanfiin kun qe'ee isaanii irraa akka godaanan dhiibbaa gochuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu amanu.

title: IRGC says it intercepted drone over Strait of Hormuz
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps claims to have successfully downed an MQ-9 Reaper drone flying above the Strait of Hormuz. State-affiliated reports indicate that the aircraft was struck by Iranian air defense units. While the drone's ownership remains unconfirmed, the United States military is known to be the primary operator of this specific aircraft model.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ሰራዊት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ ይበር የነበረ MQ-9 ሪፐር የተሰኘ ድሮን መትቶ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። ድሮኑ የኢራን የአየር መከላከያ ስርዓትን በመጠቀም እንደተመታ ዘገባዎች ያመለክታሉ። ምንም እንኳን የድሮኑ ባለቤት ማን እንደሆነ በግልጽ ባይታወቅም፣ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ አየር ኃይል የዚህ አይነት ድሮኖች ዋና ተጠቃሚ እንደሆነ ይታወቃል።
oromo: Humnooti Eegumsa Maphuuraa Islaamaa kan Iraan, xiyyaara nama hin qabne (drone) gosa MQ-9 Reaper jedhamu kan galaana Hormuz irra balali'aa ture rukutanii kuffisuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, xiyyaarichi kutaalee ittisa qilleensa Iraaniin kan rukutame ta'uun ibsameera. Haala kanaan, xiyyaarichi kan eenyuu akka ta'e hanga ammaatti ifa ba'uu baatus, waraanni Yuunaayitid Isteets xiyyaarota gosa kanaa gurguddoo akka fayyadamu ni beekama.

title: 'We will rise again': A new generation of Tunisians prepare for Ennahda's return
english: Despite five years of severe crackdowns, imprisonment of its leaders, and the dismantling of democratic institutions under President Kais Saied, the Ennahda movement remains defiant. Younger supporters believe the group is using this period of exclusion to reform its leadership and address past errors. They argue that the movement is experiencing a resurgence and remains a relevant political force that will eventually return to the Tunisian scene.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ካይስ ሰይድ ስልጣን ከያዙበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ ለአምስት ዓመታት የዘለቀው የአፈና እርምጃ እና የኢናህዳ መሪዎች እስራት ቢኖርም፣ ንቅናቄው እንደገና ለመነሳት እየተዘጋጀ ነው። የወጣቱ ትውልድ ደጋፊዎች እንደሚሉት፣ ይህ አስቸጋሪ ጊዜ ቡድኑን የውስጥ መሪዎችን እንዲያድስ እና ያለፉ ስህተቶችን እንዲያርም ዕድል ሰጥቶታል። የኢናህዳ ደጋፊዎች በቱኒዚያ ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ያላቸው ተፅእኖ አሁንም ጠንካራ እንደሆነ እና ወደፊትም በስልጣን ላይ እንደሚመለሱ ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Pireezidaant Kaayiis Saayid aangoo qabatanii waggaa shan guutuu tarkaanfiin cimaan irratti fudhatamuufi hoggantoonni isaanii hidhamuu isaanii illee, dhaabni Inahdaa deebi'ee dhaabbachuuf qophaa'aa jira. Dargaggoonni deggartoota ta'an, yeroon rakkinaa kun dhaabichaaf gaggeessitoota isaa haaromsuufi dogoggoroota darban sirreessuuf carraa guddaa akka ta'e dubbatu. Inahdaan ammas humna siyaasaa cimaa ta'uu isaa fi gara fuulduraatti gara dirree siyaasaa biyyattii deebi'uuf akka of qopheessaa jiru ibsu.

title: Iran says currently no negotiations with US
english: The Iranian foreign ministry has clarified that it is not engaged in any direct talks with the United States at this time. Instead, officials are holding constructive discussions with Oman focused on establishing a new shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz. Iran maintains that the ongoing US naval blockade must be addressed for any significant changes to the regional security situation.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር በአሁኑ ወቅት ከአሜሪካ ጋር ምንም አይነት ድርድር እንደሌለ አስታውቋል። በምትኩ፣ ሀገሪቱ በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር አዲስ የመርከብ መስመር ለመፍጠር ከኦማን ጋር ገንቢ ውይይት እያደረገች ነው። ኢራን በአካባቢው የባህር ላይ ደህንነት ላይ ለውጥ እንዲመጣ የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል እገዳ መነሳት እንዳለበት አሳስባለች።
oromo: Ministeerri dhimmi alaa Iraan yeroo ammaa kana Ameerikaa waliin mariin kamiyyuu akka hin jirre ibseera. Kanaa mannaa, mootummaan Iraan karaa daandii galaana Hormuz haaraa ta'e irratti marii bu'a qabeessa ta'e Oomaan waliin taasisaa jira. Iraan, nageenyi naannichaa akka fooyya'uuf daandiin galaana irratti Ameerikaan godhite kun kaafamuu akka qabu ibsiteetti.

title: How Israeli presence in Forest City exposes the Zionist-aligned underbelly of Malaysia
english: Malaysian authorities are investigating allegations that Israeli citizens are involved in a private residential community in Johor, following a government vow to deport any Israelis found in the country. While an initial inspection of the Network School found no major violations, officials identified 19 individuals they could not track and subsequently issued citations for operating without a proper license. Despite pressure from the United States to reconsider its stance, Malaysia maintains that it will not recognize Israel or alter its strict immigration policies.
amharic: የማሌዥያ መንግስት በአገሪቱ ውስጥ የሚገኙ እስራኤላውያንን በሙሉ እንደሚያስወጣ ካስታወቀ በኋላ፣ በጆሆር ግዛት ውስጥ ባሉ የግል የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎች እስራኤላውያን መኖራቸውን በሚመለከት ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ነው። ባለስልጣናት በኔትዎርክ ትምህርት ቤት ባደረጉት ፍተሻ ምንም አይነት ከባድ ጥሰት ባያገኙም፣ አድራሻቸው ያልታወቁ 19 ግለሰቦችን ለይተው ትምህርት ቤቱም ህጋዊ ፈቃድ እንደሌለው ደርሰውበታል። አሜሪካ አቋሟን እንድትቀይር ግፊት ብታደርግም፣ ማሌዥያ እስራኤልን እንደማትቀበል እና የስደተኞች ፖሊሲዋን እንደማትቀይር አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Maaleeshiyaa biyyattii keessa namoota Israa'el jiraatan hunda akka ari'u ibsuu hordofee, naannoo Johor keessatti jiraattonni Israa'el iddoo dhuunfaa tokko keessa jiraachuu isaanii qorannoon eegalameera. Qorannoo mana barnootaa 'Network School' irratti godhamee kanaan yakki guddaan argamuu baatus, namoota 19 bakki jiran hin beekamne adda baafamee jira akkasumas mana barnootichaa hayyama malee hojjechaa akka ture mirkanaa'eera. Ameerikaan murtii kana akka jijjiirtu dhiibbaa gootee jirtus, Maaleeshiyaan Israa'el akka hin beekne fi imaammata ishee kan hin jijjiirre ta'uu ibsiteetti.

title: Jasprit Bumrah ruled out of Sri Lanka Test series due to injury
english: Indian cricket star Jasprit Bumrah will miss the upcoming two-match Test series against Sri Lanka due to an ongoing knee injury sustained during a game in the UK. The BCCI has selected uncapped fast bowler Auqib Nabi as his replacement for the tour. Nabi, who has shown strong performance in domestic competitions, becomes the first player from Jammu and Kashmir to join the national senior Test squad.
amharic: የህንድ የክሪኬት ኮከብ የሆነው ጃስፕሪት ቡምራ በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም በነበረው ውድድር በጉልበቱ ላይ በደረሰበት ጉዳት ምክንያት ከስሪ ላንካ ጋር በሚደረገው የሁለት የቴስት ጨዋታዎች ተከታታይ ውድድር አይሳተፍም። የህንድ ክሪኬት ቦርድ የእሱን ቦታ ለመተካት አውቂብ ናቢ የተባለውን ተጫዋች መርጧል። በአገር ውስጥ ውድድሮች ጥሩ ብቃት ያሳየው ናቢ፣ ከጃሙ እና ካሽሚር ክልል ወደ ብሔራዊ የቴስት ቡድን የተመረጠ የመጀመሪያው ተጫዋች ሆኗል።
oromo: Leeyyuun kriketii Hindii Jasprit Bumrah miidhaa jilba isaatiin kan ka’e, taphoota lama Sri Lanka wajjin ta’uuf jiru keessatti hin hirmaatu. Koreen kriketii Hindii bakka isaa buusuuf ariifataa Auqib Nabi jedhamu filateera. Auqib Nabi taphoota biyya keessaa irratti guddina agarsiise, naannoo Jammu fi Kaashmiir irraa gara gita taphattoota biyyaalessaa kan darbe isa jalqabaa ta’eera.

title: ‘Tell us’: Gaza family trapped between hope and pain over missing brothers
english: A Palestinian family in Gaza is enduring deep agony as they search for two brothers, Othman and Sami, who went missing over a year ago. The boys disappeared while traveling to collect food and personal items amidst the ongoing conflict that has displaced their family. Despite their desperate efforts to find answers, the parents remain trapped in a state of uncertainty, hoping for their children's safe return.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚኖር አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ ቤተሰብ ከዓመት በፊት የጠፉባቸውን ሁለት ወንዶች ልጆቻቸውን ኦስማን እና ሳሚን በመፈለግ ከፍተኛ ስቃይ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ወንድማማቾቹ በጦርነቱ ምክንያት መፈናቀላቸውን ተከትሎ ምግብ እና የቤት እቃዎችን ለመፈለግ በሄዱበት ወቅት ነበር የጠፉት። ወላጆቹ ልጆቻቸውን ለማግኘት ከፍተኛ ጥረት ቢያደርጉም እስካሁን ምንም አይነት መረጃ ባለማግኘታቸው የልጆቻቸውን መመለስ በመጠባበቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Maatii Falasxiin kan Gaaza keessa jiraatan keessaa ijoolleen dhiiraa lama, Usmaan fi Saamiin, waggaa tokko oliif dhabamanii argamuu dhabuun isaanii maatiicha miidhaa cimaa irra buusee jira. Obboloonni kunneen waraana iddoo isaanii irraa isaan buqqaase keessatti nyaata fi wantoota barbaachisoo ta'an barbaacha osoo deemanii akka tasaa badani. Maatiin kun ijoollee isaanii argachuuf carraaqqii cimaa godhaa kan jiran ta'us, hanga ammaatti waa'ee isaanii homaa waan hin beekneef abdii fi gaddaan guutamee jira.

title: Grid failure plunges Cuba into nationwide blackout
english: Cuba is experiencing a total nationwide power grid collapse, leaving the island in complete darkness. This failure follows ongoing issues with aging infrastructure, chronic fuel shortages, and insufficient maintenance of the country's power plants. Authorities are now working to restore electricity by gradually rebuilding isolated power networks, though they have not provided a timeline for full recovery.
amharic: ኩባ በአገሪቱ የኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል መረብ ሙሉ በሙሉ በመውደሙ ምክንያት ለከፍተኛ የኃይል መቆራረጥ ተዳርጋለች። ይህ ችግር የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫዎች አርጅተው መቆየታቸውን፣ የነዳጅ እጥረት መኖሩን እና ተገቢው ጥገና አለመደረጉን ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው። የኩባ ባለስልጣናት በደረጃ በደረጃ የተለዩ የኃይል መረቦችን በመገንባት ኃይልን ለመመለስ እየሞከሩ ቢሆንም፣ የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦቱ ሙሉ ለሙሉ መቼ እንደሚመለስ የታወቀ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Kuba keessatti sirni ibsaa biyyoolessaa guutummaatti waan dhabameef biyyittiin dukkana keessa galtee jirti. Rakkoon kun kan dhufe bu’uuraalee misoomaa dullaa’aniifi hanqina boba’aa akkasumas suuraa buufataalee humna ibsaa irraa kan maddu dha. Aangeyyotni biyyittii humna ibsaa deebisanii fiduuf tattaaffii gochaa jiranis, yeroo ammaa kanatti ibsi guutummaatti yoom akka deebi’u ifa hin taane.

title: Refugee Convention at 75: Britain owes Palestine an answer
english: The 75th anniversary of the 1951 Refugee Convention highlights the historical irony that Palestinians remain excluded from its standard protections. A new legal petition argues that Britain’s colonial policies between 1917 and 1948 directly fueled the Palestinian refugee crisis and that the UK now has a moral and legal duty to apologize. Experts maintain that because British actions helped create this ongoing displacement, the government must address its historical accountability rather than ignoring its past obligations.
amharic: የ1951 የስደተኞች ኮንቬንሽን 75ኛ ዓመት የምስረታ በዓል ፍልስጤማውያን ከመደበኛው ዓለም አቀፍ ጥበቃ ውጭ መሆናቸውን አስታዋሽ ሆኗል። አዲስ የቀረበ የህግ አቤቱታ ብሪታንያ ከ1917 እስከ 1948 ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ የነበራት ቅኝ ገዥነት ፖሊሲ ለፍልስጤማውያን ስደተኞች ቀውስ ዋና ምክንያት እንደሆነ በመጥቀስ፣ የእንግሊዝ መንግሥት በታሪካዊ ድርጊቱ ይቅርታ መጠየቅ እንዳለበት ያሳስባል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ብሪታንያ ለዚህ መፈናቀል ምክንያት በመሆኗ፣ ባለፈው የፈጸመችውን የህግ ጥሰት በመቀበል ለፍልስጤማውያን መፍትሄ የመፈለግ ኃላፊነት አለባት።
oromo: Guyyaan yaadannoo waggaa 75ffaa konveenshinii baqattootaa bara 1951, lammiileen Filisxeem erga buqqa'anii waggaa dheeraa lakkoofsiseera. Dhimmi kun, siyaasni biyyi Ingilizii bara 1917 hanga 1948 turerakkoo baqattoota Filisxeem akka uumamu sababa ta'uu isaa fi amma mootummaan Ingilizii dogoggora kanaaf gaaffii kaasuun dirqama akka qabu ibsa. Hayyoonni akka jedhanitti, Ingilizii rakkoo kana keessatti qooda waan qabduuf, seenaa ishee kana fudhattee dhiifama gaafachuu fi jijjiirama fiduuf itti gaafatamummaa qabdi.

title: Why Israel is a friend of budding autocrats around the world
english: Recent evidence confirms that private Israeli surveillance firms, such as the NSO Group, act as extensions of the Israeli government to advance its diplomatic interests. By providing sophisticated spyware like Pegasus to various regimes, Israel gains significant political leverage through access to sensitive data collected from journalists and activists globally. This close collaboration between the state and private tech companies allows Israel to build strategic alliances with foreign governments by offering them tools for monitoring and control.
amharic: እንደ NSO Group ያሉ የግል የእስራኤል የስለላ ድርጅቶች የእስራኤልን መንግስት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥቅም ለማስጠበቅ እንደሚሰሩ የቅርብ ጊዜ መረጃዎች ያመለክታሉ። እስራኤል እንደ Pegasus ያሉ የተራቀቁ የስለላ መሳሪያዎችን ለተለያዩ ሀገራት በማቅረብ፣ በጋዜጠኞችና በተሟጋቾች ላይ የሚሰበሰበውን መረጃ በመጠቀም ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ ፈጣሪነትን ታገኛለች። በመንግስትና በቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች መካከል ያለው ይህ ጥብቅ ትብብር እስራኤል ለሌሎች መንግስታት የስለላ መሳሪያዎችን በመስጠት ስልታዊ ወዳጅነት እንድትፈጥር ያስችላታል።
oromo: Dhaabbileen icciitii qoratan kan Israa'el kan akka garee NSO, faayidaa diippilomaasii mootummaa Israa'el kabachiisuuf kan hojjetan ta'uun ragaan mirkanaa'eera. Israa'el meeshaalee qorannoo ammayyaa kan akka Pegaasasiin biyyoota gara garaaf dhiheessuudhaan, odeeffannoo gaazexeessitootaa fi qabsoo mirga namoomaa irratti argamu fayyadamuun dhiibbaa siyaasaa cimaa gochuu dandeessi. Walitti dhufeenyi mootummaa fi dhaabbilee teeknoolojii gidduu jiru kun, Israa'el biyyoota biroo wajjin michummaa cimaa akka uummattuuf meeshaalee hordoffii akka fayyadamaniif kennuun gargaara.

title: Morning update
english: President Trump announced upcoming negotiations with Iran after suspending military strikes, while reports emerged of an explosion near a tanker off the coast of Oman. Meanwhile, Israel launched significant bombing raids in southern Lebanon, causing widespread fires, and a 5.6 magnitude earthquake was recorded near Egypt's Suez region. Regional authorities have activated emergency plans to address these unfolding security and natural disaster events.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ከመሰንዘር በመቆጠብ ድርድር ለመጀመር መወሰናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ በእስራኤል እና በደቡብ ሊባኖስ መካከል ግጭት ተባብሶ ከፍተኛ የቦምብ ድብደባዎች የተካሄዱ ሲሆን በግብፅም የ5.6 ማግኒቱድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ተከስቷል። ባለሥልጣናት እነዚህን ያልተጠበቁ የደህንነት እና የተፈጥሮ አደጋ ክስተቶች ለመቆጣጠር የአደጋ ጊዜ ምላሽ እቅዶችን ተግባራዊ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Traamp Iran irratti haleellaa waraanaa raawwachuu dhaabuun marii eegaluuf murteessuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaatuuttis, Israa'el fi Libaanoos gidduutti walitti bu'iinsi hammaatee haleellaan roorroo xiyyaaraa gaggeeffameera; akkasumas Masrii keessatti sochiin lafaa guddina 5.6 ta'e mudateera. Mootummoonni naannoolee kanaa rakkoolee nageenyaa fi balaa uumamaa mudatan kana ittisuuf sagantaa ariifachiisaa hojii irra oolchuutti jiru.

title: Israeli forces drop missiles, phosphorus bombs on southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military aircraft conducted missile strikes near Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon, causing loud explosions in the area. Additionally, the use of phosphorus munitions in towns like Yaroun and Bint Jbeil ignited significant fires in local forests. Israeli ground forces also engaged in machine-gun fire near the region of Wadi Hamoul.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላኖች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው ናባቲዬ አል-ፋውቃ አቅራቢያ የሚሳይል ጥቃቶችን በመፈጸማቸው በአካባቢው ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎች ተሰምተዋል። በተጨማሪም በያሩን እና ቢንት ጅቤል ከተሞች የተጣሉት የፎስፈረስ ቦምቦች በወይራ እና በጥድ ደኖች ላይ ከፍተኛ እሳት አቀጣጥለዋል። ከዚህም በላይ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በዋዲ ሀሙል አቅራቢያ በመትረየስ ጥቃት ከፍተዋል።
oromo: Xiyyaaroonni waraana Israa'el kibba Libanon, naannoo Nabatiye Al-Fawqaaatti haleellaa misaayilii raawwataniiru, kunis magaalaawwan ollaa jiranitti sagalee guddaa uumeera. Kana malees, magaalota akka Yaroon fi Bint Jbeil keessatti boombiiwwan foosfarasii gadhiifamaniin bosona ejersaa fi muka birbirsaa irratti ibidda guddaatu ka'e. Dabalataanis, waraanni Israa'el naannoo Waadii Hamuulitti qawweewwan gurguddaan dhukaasa bananiiru.

title: Iran executes two accused of colluding with Israel's Mossad
english: Iranian authorities have carried out the death penalty against two men convicted of collaborating with the Israeli intelligence agency, Mossad. The individuals, named Omid Behzad and Pourya Safwat, were found guilty of passing classified security data and military location details to foreign agents. This action follows accusations that they provided sensitive information that threatened national security.
amharic: የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ከእስራኤል የደህንነት ተቋም ሞሳድ ጋር በመተባበር ወንጀል የተከሰሱ ሁለት ግለሰቦችን በሞት ቀጥተዋል። ኦሚድ ቤህዛድ እና ፑርያ ሳፍዋት የተባሉት እነዚህ ግለሰቦች፣ ሚስጥራዊ የሆኑ ወታደራዊ መረጃዎችን እና የቦታ መገኛዎችን ለውጭ ኃይሎች አሳልፈው በመስጠት ተከሰው ነበር። ድርጊታቸው ለሀገሪቱ ደህንነት ስጋት በመሆኑ የሞት ፍርዱ እንደተፈጸመባቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraan namoota lama kanneen ejensii basaastuu Israa'el kan ta'e 'Mossad' waliin walta'anii hojjechuun himataman ajjeeseera. Namoonni Omid Behzad fi Pourya Safwat jedhaman kunneen, odeeffannoo fi qindoomina iddoo waraanaa icitii qabu diinaaf dabarsanii kennuun himataman. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame gochi isaanii nageenya biyyattii irratti balaa waan qaqqabsiiseef dha.

title: Trump suggests new talks with Iran to begin on Monday
english: President Donald Trump announced that new negotiations with Iran are scheduled to start on Monday, following his decision to call off planned military strikes. He claimed that regional allies and Iranian officials requested a pause to focus on reaching agreements regarding the Strait of Hormuz and nuclear issues. While Trump expressed optimism about these talks, Iranian authorities have denied requesting any halt to military action and labeled his statements as untrue.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ሊወስዱት የነበረውን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ መሰረዛቸውን ተከትሎ፣ ከኢራን ጋር አዲስ ድርድር ሰኞ እንደሚጀመር አስታውቀዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ የክልሉ አጋሮች እና የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በሆርሙዝ ባህር እና በኒውክሌር ጉዳዮች ላይ ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ እንዲቻል ጥቃት እንዳይሰነዘር መጠየቃቸውን ገልጸዋል። ሆኖም የኢራን ባለስልጣናት እንዲህ አይነት ጥያቄ እንዳላቀረቡ በመግለጽ የትራምፕን ንግግር ውድቅ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp tarkaanfii waraanaa Iiraan irratti fudhachuuf karoorfatanii turan haquun, mariin haaraan Iiraan wajjin akka jalqabu beeksisaniiru. Pirezidaantichi biyyoonni ollaa fi hoggantoonni Iiraan dhimmoota Hormuz fi niwukilaraa irratti waliigaltee irra gahuuf waraanni akka hin banamne gaafachuu isaanii dubbatan. Haata'u malee, hoggantoonni Iiraan gaaffii akkasii akka hin dhiyeessine himuun, ibsa Traamp kijiba jedhaniiru.

title: 'My only son was shot standing up for justice' - inside city gripped by deadly protests in Pakistan-administered Kashmir
english: Violent clashes have erupted in Pakistan-administered Kashmir as protesters from the Joint Awami Action Committee demonstrate against high costs of living and a lack of basic services. Demonstrators report that security forces are using live ammunition, leading to numerous deaths and injuries among young people. Because many wounded individuals fear arrest, they are relying on makeshift clinics rather than seeking professional medical care at main hospitals.
amharic: በፓኪስታን አስተዳደር ስር ባለው ካሽሚር፣ የኑሮ ውድነትን እና መሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶች አለመሟላትን በመቃወም በጋራ አዋሚ የድርጊት ኮሚቴ እየተመሩ ያሉ ተቃውሞዎች ወደ ግጭት አምርተዋል። የፀጥታ አስከባሪዎች በእውነተኛ ጥይት እየተኮሱ በመሆኑ ብዙ ወጣቶች መሞታቸውና መቁሰላቸው ተነግሯል። ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሰዎች በዋና ዋና ሆስፒታሎች ውስጥ እንደሚታሰሩ በመስጋት ወደ ጊዜያዊ የህክምና ማዕከላት ለመሄድ ተገደዋል።
oromo: Kashmiir kan Paakistaaniin bulchitu keessatti, mormitoonni gatii jireenyaa fi tajaajila bu'uuraa dhabuu mormuudhaan walitti buiinsa hamaa keessa galanii jiru. Humnoonni nageenyaa dhukaasa lubbuu balleessuuf fayyadamuun isaanii dargaggoonni baay'een akka ajjeefamanii fi madaayan godheera. Namoonni miidhaman hospitaalota gurguddaa keessatti qabamuu waan sodaataniif, gargaarsa wal'aansaa argachuuf gara giddugala yaalaa yerootti deemuuf dirqamaniiru.

title: Massive Attack respond after Singapore ban over Palestine display
english: The band Massive Attack has been permanently banned from performing in Singapore after displaying a Palestinian flag and chanting slogans during their concert. The group reported being detained and questioned by local police, stating they were surprised by the harsh reaction to their display of solidarity. Singaporean authorities maintain strict laws regarding political expression and public assembly, leading to the decision to deny the artists future entry into the country.
amharic: ማሲቭ አታክ የተሰኘው የሙዚቃ ቡድን በሲንጋፖር ኮንሰርታቸው ላይ የፍልስጤምን ባንዲራ በማውለብለባቸው እና የድጋፍ መፈክር በማሰማታቸው ወደ ሀገሪቱ እንዳይገቡ ለዘለቄታው ታግደዋል። ቡድኑ በሀገሪቱ ፖሊስ ታስረው ምርመራ እንደተደረገባቸው ገልጸው፣ ለተቃውሞ መግለጫቸው የተሰጠው ምላሽ አስደንጋጭ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። የሲንጋፖር መንግሥት በፖለቲካዊ መግለጫዎች እና በሕዝባዊ ስብሰባዎች ላይ ጥብቅ ህጎች ስላሉት፣ በባንዱ ላይ ይህንን እርምጃ ወስዷል።
oromo: gareen muuziqaa Massive Attack jedhamu, konsertii Singapooriitti sagantaa isaanii irratti alaabaa Filisxeem ol kaasuun fi dhaadannoo deggersaa dhageessisuun isaanii hordofee biyyattii keessatti akka hin mul'anne dhorkamee jira. Gareen kun poolisoota Singapooriin qabamee gaaffii fi deebii akka godhameefi, tarkaanfiin fudhatame sunis akka isaan dinqisiise ibsaniiru. Singapooriin seera ibsa siyaasaa fi walga'ii uummataa irratti qabduun cimtuu waan taateef, artistoota kana biyyattii keessatti akka hin hojjenne dhorkiteetti.

title: Ariana Grande to take a break from public life amid 'endless' scrutiny
english: Singer Ariana Grande plans to step away from public life after finishing her current concert tour next month. This decision comes as she deals with persistent and intrusive media speculation regarding her physical appearance and health. Consequently, she has withdrawn from her upcoming role in the London musical Sunday in the Park with George to prioritize her well-being.
amharic: አርቲስት አሪያና ግራንዴ የሙዚቃ ጉብኝቷን በሚቀጥለው ወር ካጠናቀቀች በኋላ ከህዝባዊ ህይወት ራቅ ብላ ለመቆየት መወሰኗን አስታውቃለች። ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰነችው በጤንነቷ እና በአካላዊ መልክዋ ላይ የሚነዛው የማያቋርጥ የህዝብ ትችት እና ወሬ በመጨመሩ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት በአዲሱ የለንደን የሙዚቃ ቲያትር ላይ ለመሳተፍ የነበራትን እቅድ ሰርዛለች።
oromo: Sirbituu Ariyaanaa Giraande daawwii muuziqaa ishee ji'a dhufu erga xumurtee booda jireenya hawaasummaa irraa yeroof addaan ba'uuf murteessiteetti. Murteen kun kan dhufef waa'ee qaama ishee fi fayyaa ishee irratti qeeqni fi oduun baay'inaan ka'aa waan jiruufidha. Kana irraa kan ka'e, tiyaatira muuziqaa Lonodanii irratti hirmaachuuf karoorsite turte haquun ishee beekameera.

title: Fires in Spokane, Washington, burn 600 structures, force 60,000 evacuations
english: Severe wildfires in Spokane, Washington, have resulted in the destruction of at least 600 buildings and forced 60,000 residents to flee their homes. While no injuries have been reported so far, the fires remain uncontained across a significant portion of the state. Authorities warn that dangerous, dry conditions will likely persist, making the coming days difficult for emergency responders.
amharic: በዋሽንግተን ስቴት ስፖኬን አካባቢ የተቀሰቀሰው የሰደድ እሳት ቢያንስ 600 ሕንፃዎችን ያወደመ ሲሆን 60,000 ነዋሪዎችም አካባቢያቸውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተገደዋል። እስካሁን በሰዎች ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት ባይዘገብም፣ እሳቱ አሁንም በቁጥጥር ስር አልዋለም። ባለስልጣናት ደረቅ የአየር ሁኔታው እንደሚቀጥል በመግለጽ፣ በቀጣዮቹ ቀናት የነፍስ አድን ስራው ፈታኝ ሊሆን እንደሚችል አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ibidda cimaa magaalaa Spokane, Washington keessatti ka’een manniifi qabeenyi hedduun miidhameera. Ibiddisa kanaan namoonni 60,000 ol ta’an manneen isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqataniif kan dirqaman yoo ta’u, manneen 600 ol ta’anis barbada’aniiru. Haga ammaatti namoota miidhamaniin kan hin jirre ta’us, ibiddisi guutummaatti to’atamuun isaa hin milkoofne. Mootummaan akka ibsetti, qilleensi gogaan kun itti fufuun isaa hojii dhaamsaa ibiddaa kanaa guyyoota dhufan keessatti rakkisaa akka taasisu akeekkachiiseera.

title: Trump pauses ‘massive attack’ on Iran, says new talks to begin
english: President Donald Trump decided to cancel a large-scale military strike against Iran at the last minute. Instead of engaging in conflict, he announced that diplomatic negotiations between the two nations are scheduled to start on Monday. The administration is now shifting its focus toward resolving tensions through official dialogue.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ሊፈጽሙት የነበረውን መጠነ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት የመጨረሻ ሰዓት ላይ ሰርዘውታል። ግጭት ውስጥ ከመግባት ይልቅ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል የሚደረግ የዲፕሎማሲ ውይይት ሰኞ እንደሚጀምር አስታውቀዋል። የአሜሪካ መንግስት አሁን ትኩረቱን በውይይት አማካኝነት አለመግባባቶችን ለመፍታት አዙሯል።
oromo: Pirezedaanti Doonaald Tiraamp weerara waraanaa guddaa Iraan irratti raawwachuuf qophaa’anii turan yeroodhuma dhumaa irratti haqaniiru. Walitti bu’iinsa keessa galuu mannaa, mariin nageenyaa biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhamu akka jalqabu beeksisaniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa ammaan tana xiyyeeffannaa isaa rakkoolee jiran mariidhaan furuu irratti godhateera.

title: Brazil’s Lula launches reelection bid amid foreign interference concerns
english: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has formally started his campaign for another term in office. During the announcement, he emphasized the need to protect the nation's sovereignty from outside influence. The reelection bid comes as political division intensifies ahead of the upcoming October vote.
amharic: የብራዚሉ ፕሬዝዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ለሁለተኛ የስልጣን ዘመን መወዳደራቸውን በይፋ አሳውቀዋል። በዘመቻው መክፈቻ ላይ የሀገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነት ከውጭ ጣልቃ ገብነት ለመጠበቅ እንደሚሰሩ አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል። ይህ የዘመቻ ጅምር በጥቅምት ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ዙሪያ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ባለበት ወቅት የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin biyya Braazil Luwiiz Inaasiyoo Luulaa daa Siilvaa iddoo hojii isaanii itti fufachuuf duula filannoo isaanii ifatti jalqabaniiru. Yeroo kana ibsa kennaniin, aangoo fi bilisummaa biyyattii giddu galchuun dhiibbaa biyyoota alaa irraa akka ittisan ibsaniiru. Duulli filannoo kun kan jalqabame, filannoo dhufu kan ji'a Onkololeessaa dura waldhabdee siyaasaa cimaa keessa jiran keessatti dha.

title: The battle for the Maasai Mara: Can Kenya’s most iconic ecosystem be saved?
english: Kenya's iconic Maasai Mara reserve is facing serious environmental threats due to the rapid growth of luxury tourism infrastructure. Conservation groups have taken legal action against several major hotel brands and government bodies to stop the construction of new camps in sensitive ecological zones. The petitioners argue that these developments lack proper environmental assessments and disrupt critical wildlife migration routes.
amharic: የኬንያው ታዋቂው ማሳይ ማራ መጠለያ፣ በቱሪዝም መሰረተ ልማቶች መስፋፋት ምክንያት ከባድ የአካባቢ ስጋት ተጋርጦበታል። የጥበቃ ቡድኖች በአስፈላጊ የተፈጥሮ ቀጠናዎች ላይ እየተገነቡ ያሉ የቅንጦት ካምፖችን ለማስቆም በበርካታ የሆቴል ኩባንያዎች እና የመንግስት አካላት ላይ ክስ መስርተዋል። ከሳሾቹ እነዚህ ግንባታዎች የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ግምገማ እንደሌላቸው እና ለዱር እንስሳት መደበኛ የፍልሰት መንገድ እንቅፋት እንደሚሆኑ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Bu'uuree eegumsa bineeldootaa kan Maasai Maaraa jedhamu, babal'achuu mana jireenyaa fi bakka bashannanaa qananii kanneen suuta jedhanii naannoo sana miidhaa jiraniin rakkoo cimaa keessa galee jira. Gareewwan eegumsa uumamaa, dhaabbilee hoteelaa fi qaamolee mootummaa irratti himannaa banuun, ijaarsa kaampiiwwan haaraa bakka bineeldonni itti deddeebi'an keessatti akka dhaabatu gaafachaa jiru. Himattoonni kun, ijaarsi kun qorannoo eegumsa naannoo kan hin qabne fi karaa bineeldonni itti godaanan gufachiisaa jiraachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Japan and US confirm rare joint intervention to prop up yen
english: Japan and the United States have launched a rare coordinated effort to strengthen the Japanese yen after it hit a 40-year low. President Trump stated that this move is intended to stabilize the global economy and support a key ally. Following the announcement, the yen's value increased significantly, though this caused a decline in Japanese stock prices.
amharic: ጃፓን እና አሜሪካ የጃፓን የመገበያያ ገንዘብ የሆነው የየን ዋጋ በ40 ዓመታት ውስጥ ዝቅተኛ ደረጃ ላይ በመድረሱ የተነሳ የገንዘቡን ዋጋ ለመደገፍ በጋራ እርምጃ ወስደዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ እንደገለጹት ይህ የጋራ ጥረት ዓለም አቀፍ ኢኮኖሚን ለማረጋጋት እና ለጃፓን ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ለማሳየት ያለመ ነው። ይህንን ተከትሎ የየን ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቢጨምርም በጃፓን የአክሲዮን ገበያ ላይ ግን አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Jaappaan fi Ameerikaan gatiin maallaqa Jaappaan kan 'Yen' jedhamu gadi bu'uusaatiin kan ka'e, gatii isaa dabaluuf hojii gamtaa cimaa tokko jalqabaniiru. Preezdaanti Tiraamp akka ibsanitti, tarkaanfiin kun diinagdee addunyaa tasgabbeessuufi hariiroo jaalalaan kan taasifameedha. Labsii kanaan booda gatiin maallaqa Yen saffisaan kan dabale yoo ta'u, kunis gabaa aksiyoona Jaappaan irratti dhiibbaa uumuudhaan gatii aksiyoonotaa hir'iseera.

title: Earthquake of magnitude 5.6 hits Egypt
english: A 5.6 magnitude earthquake occurred early Monday morning near the city of Suez in Egypt. Following the tremors, the Egyptian Red Crescent immediately put its emergency response systems into action across the affected areas. There have been no reports of major damage or casualties at this time.
amharic: የ5.6 ማግኒቲዩድ መጠን ያለው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ሰኞ ማለዳ ላይ በግብፅ የሱዌዝ ከተማ አቅራቢያ ተከስቷል። የግብፅ ቀይ ጨረቃ ማህበር መንቀጥቀጡ በተሰማባቸው አካባቢዎች የአደጋ ጊዜ ምላሽ ስራውን ማግበሩን አስታውቋል። እስካሁን ስለደረሰው ጉዳት ወይም የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት የተገለጸ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Roobii ganama keessa naannoo magaalaa Suweez kan biyya Gibxiitti sochiin lafaa hamma 5.6 qabu tokko mudateera. Sochiin lafaa kun erga mudatee booda, dhaabbanni 'Egyptian Red Crescent' naannolee sochiin kun itti dhaga'ame hunda keessatti sagantaa gargaarsa ariifachiisaa hojii irra oolcheera. Hangasitti miidhaan guddaan ykn lubbuun darbe hin gabaafamne.

title: Israel's Smotrich says 'complete victory' is Gaza's resettlement
english: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich recently stated that achieving a total victory in the Gaza conflict requires the resettlement of the territory. He argued that the Palestinian population must pay a consequence for the losses and mistakes associated with the war. This controversial position suggests a policy goal of re-establishing Israeli presence in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ቤዛለል ስሞትሪች በጋዛ ሙሉ ድል ለመቀዳጀት በአካባቢው ዳግም መኖር እንደሚያስፈልግ ተናገሩ። በጦርነቱ ለተሸነፉት ወገኖች ዋጋ መከፈል አለበት ሲሉም አክለዋል። ይህ አወዛጋቢ መግለጫ በእስራኤል በኩል በጋዛ ያለውን መገኘት እንደገና ለማስፈን ያለውን ፍላጎት ያሳያል።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Israa'el Bezalel Smotrich, Gaza keessatti injifannoo guutuu argachuuf lafa sanatti deebi'anii qubachuun murteessaa akka ta'e dubbatan. Namoonni naannichaa dogoggoraa fi injifatamuu isaaniitiif gatii kaffaluu qabu jechuun yaada isaanii ibsataniiru. Yaanni kun Israa'el naannichatti deebi'ee qubachuuf karoora qabaachuu ishee kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Suicide bombing kills at least 14 people in Pakistan’s Swat Valley
english: A suicide bombing at a police station in Pakistan's Swat Valley has resulted in the deaths of at least 14 people. The explosion occurred near a location where a crowd of protesters had gathered. Authorities are currently responding to the tragedy, which took place in the Kabal area near the Afghan border.
amharic: በፓኪስታን ስዋት ሸለቆ በሚገኝ የፖሊስ ጣቢያ በተፈጸመ ራስን የማጥፋት የቦምብ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ፍንዳታው የተከሰተው በዚያ አካባቢ ተቃውሞ እያሰሙ የነበሩ ሰዎች በተሰበሰቡበት አቅራቢያ ነው። ከአፍጋኒስታን ድንበር አቅራቢያ በካባል አካባቢ በተፈጸመው በዚህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት ላይ ባለስልጣናት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Naannoo Swat Valley kan Paakistaan keessatti buufata poolisii tokko irratti haleellaa of ajjeesuun raawwatamee namoonni 14 ol du'aniiru. Dhukaatin kun kan mudate namoonni mormii geggeessaa jiran bakka jiranitti dhiyoo dha. Haleellaan kun daangaa Afgaanistaanitti dhiyoo naannoo Kaabal keessatti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, mootummaan qorannoo jalqabeera.

title: Iran war live: Trump says talks to resume; Tehran urges US to honour MoU
english: President Donald Trump has announced that negotiations with Iran will restart this coming Monday, suggesting a deal is close. In response, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian emphasized that the United States must respect the existing memorandum of understanding. He noted that this previous agreement will serve as a key foundation for Iran's future diplomatic relations.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአሜሪካ እና ከአይራን መካከል ያለው ድርድር ሰኞ እንደሚጀምር አስታውቀዋል። የኢራኑ ፕሬዝዳንት መስዑድ 페ዜሽኪያንም አሜሪካ በሰኔ ወር የተፈረመውን የመግባቢያ ስምምነት እንድታከብር ጠይቀዋል። ይህ ስምምነት ለኢራን የወደፊት የውጭ ግንኙነት ወሳኝ መሰረት እንደሚሆን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii Doonaald Tiraamp mariin biyyoota lamaanii gidduutti gaggeeffamu guyyaa Wiixataa akka jalqabu beeksisaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Pireezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaan, Ameerikaan walii galtee ji'a Waxabajjii keessa mallatteeffame akka kabajju gaafataniiru. Walii galteen kun gara fuulduraatti hariiroo alaa Iraaniif bu'uura guddaa akka ta'u ibsaniiru.

title: Trump says new round of Iran talks will begin Monday
english: President Donald Trump announced that new diplomatic negotiations with Iran are scheduled to start this Monday. He decided to cancel planned military strikes against the country after pressure from Gulf allies and a desire to seek a peaceful resolution. The talks aim to address concerns regarding the Strait of Hormuz and potential nuclear disarmament.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአሜሪካ ጋር አዲስ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ድርድር ከኢራን ጋር ሰኞ እንደሚጀምር አስታውቀዋል። የባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት ባቀረቡት ጥያቄ እና ሰላማዊ መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ በመወሰናቸው በኢራን ላይ ሊወስዱት የነበረውን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ሰርዘዋል። ንግግሮቹ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት እና በኢራን የኑክሌር መርሃ ግብር ላይ ያተኩራሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Donaald Traampii mariin dippilomaasii kan haaromfame Itoophiyaa waliin (Iran waliin) guyyaa Wiixataa akka jalqabu beeksisaniiru. Gamtaa biyyoota Gargaaraa (Gulf allies) dhiibbaa godhaniin fi furmaata nagaa barbaaduuf jecha, tarkaanfii waraanaa irratti fudhachuuf turan haquu isaanii ibsaniiru. Mariin kunis dhimma Hormuz fi dhaabbii meeshaa niwukilaraa irratti kan xiyyeeffatu ta'a.

title: Brazil’s Lula launches fourth-term bid, focuses on national sovereignty
english: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has officially launched his campaign for a fourth term, declaring it will be his final time running for office. During his announcement, he emphasized the importance of national sovereignty and protecting Brazil's mineral wealth from foreign interference. He is positioning the upcoming election as a critical choice between maintaining Brazil's independence and bowing to external interests, particularly in response to rising geopolitical tensions.
amharic: የብራዚሉ ፕሬዚዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ለአራተኛ የስልጣን ዘመን መወዳደራቸውን በይፋ አሳውቀዋል። ይህ ውድድር የመጨረሻው እንደሚሆን የገለጹት ፕሬዚዳንቱ፣ በዋናነት የሀገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነት በማስጠበቅ እና የተፈጥሮ ሀብታቸውን ከውጭ ተጽዕኖ በመከላከል ላይ እንደሚያተኩሩ ተናግረዋል። ምርጫው በሀገሪቱ ነጻነት እና በውጭ ፍላጎቶች መካከል የሚደረግ ወሳኝ የፖለቲካ ምርጫ መሆኑን በንግግራቸው አስምረውበታል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin biyya Braazil Luwiiz Inaasiyoo Luulaa daa Siilvaa, afraffaaf muummee biyyattii ta'uuf carraa isaanii ifatti labsaniiru. Hirmaannaan kun kan isa dhumaa ta'uu ibsuun, xiyyeeffannoon isaanii inni guddaan eegumsa soovereentii biyyaa fi qabeenya uumamaa Braazil giddu galeessa godhachuu akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Sagalee kenniinsa jiru kun, walaba ta'uu biyyattii fi fedhii humnoota alaa gidduutti kan murtaa'u ta'uu eeraniiru.

title: Blast reported near vessel 20 nautical miles away from Oman
english: A tanker sailing near the Omani port of Khasab reported an explosion occurring in the immediate vicinity of the ship. Fortunately, the vessel and all personnel on board remain unharmed following the incident. Maritime authorities are currently monitoring the situation after the alert was issued.
amharic: ከኦማን የካሳብ ወደብ በቅርብ ርቀት ላይ የነበረ አንድ የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከብ በአቅራቢያው ፍንዳታ እንደተሰማ ዘግቧል። እንደ እድል ሆኖ፣ በዚህ ድርጊት መርከቧም ሆነ በውስጧ የነበሩት ሰራተኞች ምንም አይነት ጉዳት አልደረሰባቸውም። የባህር ላይ ደህንነት ተቋማት ክስተቱን እየተከታተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Dooniin boba'aa fe'atte tokko buufata Omaan kan ta'e Kaasaab biratti osoo deemtuu, daangaa ishee cinaatti dhukaatiin tokko dhaga'amuu gabaasteetti. Gammachuu isaatiin, dooniin tunis ta'e namoonni irratti argaman hundi miidhaan tokkollee irra hin ga'een. Qaamoleen nageenya galaanaarratti hojjetan haala kana hordofaa jiru.

title: Sudan army drone attack on Darfur kills 35, rights group says
english: A drone strike by the Sudanese army on a traditional court in North Darfur resulted in the deaths of at least 35 people. The attack occurred in a village controlled by paramilitary forces while local community members were gathered to resolve tribal disputes. This incident is part of the ongoing violent civil war that has caused a massive humanitarian crisis and millions of displacements since it began in 2023.
amharic: የሱዳን ጦር በሰሜን ዳርፉር በሚገኝ ባህላዊ ፍርድ ቤት በፈጸመው የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 35 ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በፓራሚሊታሪ ኃይሎች ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው መንደር ውስጥ ነዋሪዎች የአካባቢውን ግጭቶች ለመፍታት በተሰበሰቡበት ወቅት ነው። ይህ ክስተት ከ2023 ጀምሮ በሀገሪቱ እየተካሄደ ያለው እና ከፍተኛ ሰብአዊ ቀውስ የፈጠረው የርስ በርስ ጦርነት አካል ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Sudaan manni murtii aadaa naannoo Daarfuur kaabaatti argamu irratti boombii xiyyaara nama hin feeneen haleeluun lubbuun namoota 35 ol darbeera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, uummanni naannichaa walitti bu'iinsa gosaa hiikuuf walgahii irra turan. Tarkaanfiin kun waraana cimaa bara 2023 jalqabee biyyattii keessatti adeemsifamaa jiru fi balaa namoomaa guddaa geessise keessaa isa tokko.

title: Wildfires force mass evacuations across the Pacific Northwest
english: Severe wildfires are spreading rapidly across Washington state, destroying over 250,000 acres of land and requiring residents near Spokane to evacuate their homes. The dangerous blazes have also reached across the border, threatening neighborhoods in British Columbia, Canada. These fires are occurring alongside international concerns regarding the intensification of global heat waves.
amharic: በዋሽንግተን ግዛት በፍጥነት እየተስፋፉ የሚገኙ የደን ቃጠሎዎች ከ250,000 ሄክታር በላይ መሬትን አውድመዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት በስፖኬን አካባቢ የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች ቤታቸውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተገደዋል። የቃጠሎው አደጋ በካናዳ ድንበር አቅራቢያ የሚገኙ ማህበረሰቦችንም ስጋት ላይ የጣለ ሲሆን፣ ሁኔታው የአለም ሙቀት መጨመር እየባሰ መምጣቱን የሚያሳይ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Ibidda bosonaa garaa jabeeffate garaa naannoo Washingtonitti babal'achaa jiruun lafti heektaara 250,000 ol ta'u barbadaa'eera. Balaa kanaan walqabatee, jiraattonni naannoo Spokane qe'ee isaanii gadi lakkisanii akka baqatan dirqamaniiru. Ibidni kun daangaa ce'ee biyya Kaanaadaa naannoo British Columbia irrattis sodaa guddaa uumee kan jiru yoo ta'u, kunis hoo'i lafaa addunyaa hammaachaa adeemuusaatiin walqabata.

title: Local volunteers help rebuild destroyed Christian monastery in Lebanon
english: Following the withdrawal of Israeli forces, volunteers have come together to restore a Catholic monastery in the village of Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh. Despite the village being primarily Shia Muslim, residents are working alongside others to repair the damage caused by recent attacks. This interfaith effort highlights a spirit of solidarity as locals return to their homes to begin the rebuilding process.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች አካባቢውን ለቀው ከወጡ በኋላ በዛውታር አል-ጋርቢያ መንደር የሚገኝ የካቶሊክ ገዳምን ለማደስ በጎ ፈቃደኞች ተሰባስበዋል። መንደሩ በአብዛኛው የሺዓ ሙስሊሞች የሚኖሩበት ቢሆንም፣ ነዋሪዎቹ በደረሰው ጥቃት የወደመውን ገዳም ለመጠገን በጋራ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ። ይህ የሃይማኖቶች ትብብር፣ ነዋሪዎቹ ቤታቸውን መልሰው ለመገንባት በሚሞክሩበት ወቅት የጋራ መተሳሰባቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el naannichaa gadi lakkisee erga ba'ee booda, namoonni fedhii isaaniitiin kaka'an ganda Zaawtaar al-Gaarbiiyaa keessatti bataskaana Kaatoolikii diigame deebisanii ijaaruuf walitti dhufaniiru. Gandichi guddinaan kan Muslimoota Shiyaa ta'us, jiraattonni miidhaa haleellaa dhiyeenya kana mudateen ga'e suphuuf walta'anii hojjechaa jiru. Tattaaffiin waloo kun jiraattonni gara manaa isaanii deebi'anii deebisanii ijaaruuf qophaa'an yeroo kanatti, tokkummaa fi wal-gargaarsa isanii kan mul'isu dha.

title: Trump says new talks with Iran to begin Monday after calling off strikes
english: President Donald Trump announced that diplomatic negotiations with Iran are scheduled to start this Monday. This decision follows his choice to cancel planned military strikes against the country. The President noted that these talks aim to reach a new agreement while avoiding further conflict.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር የሚደረጉ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ድርድሮች ሰኞ እንደሚጀምሩ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው በኢራን ላይ ታቅደው የነበሩ ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶችን ለመሰረዝ ከወሰኑ በኋላ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንቱ ድርድሩ ግጭትን ለማስወገድ እና አዲስ ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ያለመ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonald Tiraamp mariin dippilomaasii kan Iiraan waliin godhamu Dilbata booda akka jalqabu beeksisaniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufte erga weerara waraanaa Iiraan irratti karoorfamtee ture haquuf murteessanii boodadha. Pireezidaantichi mariin kun walitti buiinsa hambisuu fi waliigaltee haaraa irra gahuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: 'Board of Peace' chief says mediators working ‘around the clock’ on Gaza
english: Nickolay Mladenov, head of the Board of Peace, announced that his team is working continuously with international partners to stop the recent violence in Gaza. Despite ongoing Israeli airstrikes that have resulted in civilian casualties and the loss of critical medical supplies, mediators are pushing for a return to the agreed-upon peace roadmap. Mladenov emphasized that while maintaining peace is challenging, it remains possible through the collective efforts of all involved parties.
amharic: የሰላም ቦርድ ዋና ኃላፊ ኒኮላይ ምላዴኖቭ ቡድናቸው በጋዛ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት ለማስቆም ከአለም አቀፍ አጋሮች ጋር ሌሊትና ቀን እየሰራ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት በሲቪል ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት በማድረስ እና የህክምና ቁሳቁሶችን በማውደም ላይ ቢሆንም፣ አማላጆች የተስማሙበትን የሰላም ዕቅድ ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ምላዴኖቭ ዘላቂ ሰላም ማምጣት አስቸጋሪ ቢሆንም፣ ሁሉም ወገኖች ተባብረው ቢሰሩ ሊሳካ የሚችል መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan Boordii Nageenyaa Niikolaay Mlaadenov, gareen isaa waraana Gaaza keessatti dhiyeenya kana dhalate dhaabsisuuf qindoomina idil-addunyaa waliin halkan guyyaa hojjechaa akka jiran ibsaniiru. Duulli qilleensaa Israa'el namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa geessisuu fi qorichoota barbaachisoo ta'an balleessuu isaa itti fufeus, giddu-galeeyyonni karoorri nageenyaa waliigaltee irra itti gahame akka hojii irra ooluuf carraaqqii cimaa taasisaa jiru. Mlaadenov, nageenya dhaabbataa fiduun ulfaataa ta'us, yoo hoggantoonni hundinuu waliigaltee fi carraaqqii waloo taasisan galma gahuun danda'amuu himaniiru.

title: Saudi, Iranian foreign ministers discuss efforts to reduce regional tensions
english: The foreign ministers of Saudi Arabia and Iran held a phone conversation to address ways to lower regional tensions. Prince Faisal bin Farhan emphasized the Saudi government's dedication to fostering long-term stability and security in the area. Both officials aim to promote mutual interests and improve cooperation for the benefit of the region's populations.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ እና የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት ለመቀነስ በሚረዱ መንገዶች ዙሪያ በስልክ ተወያይተዋል። የሳውዲው ልዑል ፋይሰል ቢን ፋርሃን በክልሉ ዘላቂ ሰላምና መረጋጋት ለማምጣት መንግስታቸው ቁርጠኛ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ሁለቱ ወገኖች በጋራ ጥቅም ላይ የተመሰረተ ግንኙነትን በማጠናከር ለህዝቦች ጥቅም አብሮ ለመስራት ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa Sa’udii Arabiyaa fi Iraan naannichatti walitti bu’iinsa jiru hir’isuuf karaa bilbilaa mari’ataniiru. Amiir Fayisal biin Farhaan mootummaan Sa’udii nagaa fi tasgabbii naannichaa eeguuf kutannoo qabaachuu ibsaniiru. Gamachuun kunneenis faayidaa waliinii fi nageenya uummata naannichaa fooyyessuuf waliigalteerra gahuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: UK PM Burnham vows to be ‘relentless’ on Channel migrant crossings
english: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has committed to taking persistent action to reduce the number of migrants arriving by small boats across the English Channel. Although the country recently experienced its highest daily arrival total for 2026, the government maintains that overall crossing figures are currently 50% lower than at this time last year. Burnham emphasized his administration's determination to continue addressing this ongoing challenge.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም በእንግሊዝ ቻናል በኩል በጀልባ የሚደረጉ የስደተኞች ጉዞዎችን ለመግታት ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ገለጹ። ባለፈው ሳምንት በ2026 ከፍተኛው ዕለታዊ የስደተኞች መግቢያ ተመዝግቦ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ ባለፈው ዓመት ተመሳሳይ ወቅት ጋር ሲነጻጸር አጠቃላይ የጉዞ ቁጥር በግማሽ ቀንሷል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ይህንን ችግር ለመፍታት መንግስታቸው ያለውን ቁርጠኝነት አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira UK Andy Burnham daandii galaana Ingilizii (English Channel) fayyadamuun godaantonni doonii xiqqoon akka hin seene ittisuuf tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf waadaa galeera. Torban darbe lakkoofsi namoota guyyaatti biyyattii seenanii kan bara 2026 keessatti ol aanaa ta'e illee, guutuu waggaa darbee wajjin yoo madaalamu lakkoofsi godaantotaa dhibbeentaa 50n hir'ateera. Ministirichi rakkoo kana furuuf mootummaan isaa cichoominaan akka hojjetu ibseera.

title: Venezuela and the Dominican Republic say they will work to restore ties
english: Venezuela and the Dominican Republic have established a plan to gradually restore diplomatic relations following a breakdown caused by the disputed 2024 Venezuelan election. Under the interim leadership of President Delcy Rodriguez, Venezuela is shifting its foreign policy to align more closely with U.S. interests, which includes re-engaging with regional partners. This process follows previous efforts to resume consular services and flight operations between the two nations.
amharic: ቬኔዙኤላ እና ዶሚኒካን ሪፐብሊክ እ.ኤ.አ በ2024 በተካሄደው አወዛጋቢ ምርጫ ምክንያት የተቋረጠውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነታቸውን በደረጃ ለመመለስ ስምምነት ላይ ደርሰዋል። በጊዜያዊቷ ፕሬዝዳንት ዴልሲ ሮድሪጌዝ የሚመራው የቬኔዙኤላ መንግስት ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር እና ከክልሉ አገራት ጋር እንደገና ለመቀራረብ እየሰራ ይገኛል። ሁለቱ አገራት ቀደም ሲል በሁለቱ ዋና ከተሞች መካከል የበረራ አገልግሎቶችን እና የቆንስላ ስራዎችን እንደገና መጀመራቸው ይታወሳል።
oromo: Venezuelaafi Rippablikiin Dominikaa filannoo bara 2024 biyyattii keessatti geggeeffamee ture irratti wal-dhabdee uumameen booda, hariiroo dippilomaasii isaanii sadarkaan deebisanii dhaabuuf waliigalan. Mootummaan ce'umsaa Venezuela, kan Prezidaantii yeroo Delcy Rodriguez hogganamu, hariiroo biyyattii US wajjin cimsuufi biyyoota naannoo sanaa wajjin walitti dhufeenya uumuuf carraaqqii gochaa jira. Biyyoonni lamaan kun kanaan dura adeemsa balaliifi tajaajila konsilaa deebisanii eegaluun isaanii ni yaadatama.

title: Palestinian ‘doctor of the poor’ says he faces abuse, medical neglect in Israeli prison
english: Dr. Mazen Rantisi, a 71-year-old Palestinian physician known for providing affordable healthcare to the poor, was arrested by Israeli forces last month. He alleges that he has endured physical mistreatment and the denial of essential medical care while being detained. His charges are linked to his leadership role in a non-profit organization that manages health services for Palestinians.
amharic: ለድሆች የጤና አገልግሎት በመስጠት የሚታወቁት የ71 ዓመቱ ፍልስጤማዊው ዶክተር ማዘን ራንቲሲ ባለፈው ወር በእስራኤል ኃይሎች ታስረዋል። ዶክተሩ በእስር ቤት ውስጥ አካላዊ ጥቃት እንደተፈጸመባቸው እና አስፈላጊ የሆኑ መድኃኒቶች እንደተከለከሉ ገልጸዋል። ለእስር የተዳረጉትም ለፍልስጤማውያን የህክምና አገልግሎት በሚሰጥ በጎ አድራጎት ድርጅት ውስጥ በቦርድ ሰብሳቢነት በማገልገላቸው ነው።
oromo: Doktor Maazen Rantisi kan umriin isaanii waggaa 71 fi hiyyeeyyiif tajaajila fayyaa gatii madaalawaan kennuun beekaman, ji'a darbe humnoota Israa'eliin qabamaniiru. Doktichi mana hidhaa keessatti reebicha fi dhabuu qorichoota barbaachisaa ta'aniin miidhamuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Hidhamuun isaanii kunis dhaabbata fayyaa falaasxemootaaf tajaajila kennu tokko keessatti hogganaa ta'anii hojjechuu isaanii wajjin wal qabata.

title: Is Washington dictating the agenda for talks in Venezuela?
english: The United States is playing a central role in organizing upcoming negotiations between the Venezuelan government and opposition groups. Washington has significantly increased its influence over the country's oil income and political direction following the detention of President Nicolas Maduro on drug charges. Critics and analysts are now debating whether these US-led efforts can lead to a genuine resolution or if they are simply a way for Washington to dictate the country's future.
amharic: አሜሪካ በቬንዙዌላ መንግስት እና በተቃዋሚ ቡድኖች መካከል ሊካሄድ የታቀደውን ድርድር በማስተባበር ላይ ትገኛለች። ፕሬዝዳንት ኒኮላስ ማዱሮ በአደንዛዥ እፅ አዘዋዋሪነት ተከሰው ከተያዙ በኋላ፣ አሜሪካ በሀገሪቱ የነዳጅ ገቢ እና የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫ ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ማሳደር ጀምራለች። አሁን ላይ ጥያቄው በአሜሪካ የሚመራው ይህ ድርድር ዘላቂ መፍትሄ ያመጣል ወይስ ዋሽንግተን የራሷን ፍላጎት ለመጫን የምትጠቀምበት መሳሪያ ነው የሚለው ነው።
oromo: Amerikaa marii mootummaa fi mormituu Venisuweelaa gidduutti gaggeeffamuuf jiru irratti qooda olaanaa qabdi. Preezidaant Niikolaas Maaduuroo yakka qoricha sammuu hadoochee daddabarsuun erga qabamaniin booda, Amerikaan galii boba'aa fi adeemsa siyaasaa biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa guddaa gochaa jirti. Amma gaaffiin jiru mariin kun furmaata dhugaa fiduu danda'a moo Amerikaan fedhii mataa ishee irratti fe'uuf akka meeshaatti itti fayyadamaa jirti kan jedhu dha.

title: How much has AIPAC spent against Michigan’s Abdul El-Sayed? And why?
english: In the Michigan Democratic Senate primary, the pro-Israel group AIPAC has invested over $54 million to oppose progressive candidate Abdul El-Sayed. The group is heavily backing his opponent, Haley Stevens, aiming to defeat a candidate who is critical of Israeli government policies. This massive spending has turned the campaign into a focal point for debates regarding political influence and the party's future stance on Israel.
amharic: በሚቺጋን የዲሞክራቲክ ሴኔት የመጀመሪያ ምርጫ፣ እስራኤልን የሚደግፈው ኤይፓክ (AIPAC) የተሰኘው ቡድን ተራማጁን እጩ አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድን ለመቃወም ከ54 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ አውጥቷል። ቡድኑ የእስራኤልን ፖሊሲዎች በሚተቹ እጩዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ለማሳደር፣ ተቀናቃኛቸውን ሃሌይ ስቲቨንስን በገንዘብ እየደገፈ ይገኛል። ይህ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ወጪ ምርጫውን በፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ እና በፓርቲው የወደፊት የእስራኤል አቋም ዙሪያ ለሚነሱ ክርክሮች ማዕከል አድርጎታል።
oromo: Filannoo duraa kan senaatii Dimokraatawii Miishigan keessatti, gareen Israa'el deggaru kan AIPAC jedhamu, kaadhimamaa garaagarummaa qabu Abdul El-Sayed injifachuuf doolaara miliyoona 54 ol baaseera. Gareen kun kaadhimamtuu morkattuu isaa Haley Stevens deggaruun, namoota siyaasa Israa'el qeeqan laamshessuuf hojjechaa jira. Baasii guddaan kun, duula filannoo kana dhiibbaa siyaasaa fi ilaalcha gara fuulduraa kan paartichaan Israa'el irratti qabu irratti falmii guddaa kaasuu isaatiin iddoo xiyyeeffannoo godheera.

title: Israeli settlers attack Armenian church in Jerusalem
english: A group of Israeli settlers targeted an Armenian church located in the Old City of occupied East Jerusalem this past Sunday. According to reports, the individuals threw stones at the religious site and engaged in disrespectful behavior by spitting at the entrance. Authorities from the Jerusalem Governorate confirmed the incident.

english: The surviving crew members and the body of a deceased sailor from an Iranian commercial vessel have arrived back in Iran following a recent Ukrainian strike. Ukrainian officials have clarified that the vessel was hit by mistake and emphasized that they do not want the situation to escalate. The incident involved an accidental military engagement that resulted in a fatality.

title: Body of climber Nirmal Purja, six others recovered after Pakistan avalanche
english: A deadly avalanche on Pakistan’s Broad Peak has claimed the lives of ten international mountaineers, including the renowned climber Nirmal Purja. Rescue teams have recovered seven bodies from the mountain, while three individuals, including a Pakistani guide, remain missing. The search efforts are currently hindered by difficult terrain and adverse weather conditions in the remote Karakoram range.

title: Most Americans say Trump has gone too far on US immigration: Poll
english: A recent poll indicates that half of Americans believe President Trump has become too extreme regarding his immigration and deportation policies. While public approval of his performance on this issue has dropped to 39 percent, he maintains strong backing from the majority of his Republican base. The findings suggest that voters are more critical of his stance on immigration than his handling of the economy or the conflict with Iran.

title: Iran says negotiations with Oman over Strait of Hormuz in final stages
english: Iran has announced that discussions with Oman regarding the creation of a new maritime route through the Strait of Hormuz are nearing completion. Officials from Tehran stated that this path aims to protect their national interests and security while respecting sovereign rights, independent of the ongoing broader closure of the strait. Iran maintains that the waterway remains restricted due to US actions, and this new agreement aims to establish a mutually acceptable navigational corridor.

title: Two helicopters collide mid-air while tackling wildfires in Greece
english: Two firefighting helicopters crashed into each other while battling wildfires near Athens, Greece, on Sunday. Officials confirmed that two crew members lost their lives in the accident, while two others managed to survive. The incident occurred as the aircraft were actively working to control the blazes in the region.

title: Iran’s Pezeshkian says MoU will be ‘centre of gravity’ of its foreign relations
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has described a memorandum of understanding signed with the US as the primary focus of his country's future foreign policy. He emphasized the importance of holding the US accountable to the terms of the agreement to ensure stability for Iran and its allies. Pezeshkian noted that the deal reflects a collective consensus among Iranian leadership to improve regional security.

title: At least one Iranian soldier killed, another injured in clashes, report says
english: A violent confrontation between Iranian soldiers and armed individuals recently occurred in the border town of Marivan. According to local media reports, the skirmish resulted in the death of one soldier and left another person wounded. Authorities have not yet released further details regarding the identity of the attackers or the cause of the conflict.
