title: Centcom says it has redirected 35 vessels
english: The U.S. Central Command is actively maintaining a naval blockade to monitor and control maritime traffic in the region. Recent data indicates that military forces have successfully rerouted 35 commercial ships while also boarding two and disabling another two. These operations are being supported by air power, including stealth fighter jets operating from the USS Abraham Lincoln.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ በአካባቢው የባህር ላይ እንቅስቃሴን ለመቆጣጠር የባህር ላይ እገዳን እየተገበረ ይገኛል። ወታደራዊው ክፍል እስካሁን 35 የንግድ መርከቦችን አቅጣጫ ያስቀየረ ሲሆን፣ ሁለት መርከቦችን በመያዝ ሌላ ሁለት ደግሞ ጉዳት እንዲደርስባቸው አድርጓል። እነዚህ የቁጥጥር ስራዎች በUSS አብርሃም ሊንከን አውሮፕላን ተሸካሚ መርከብ በሚገኙ ተዋጊ ጄቶች ድጋፍ እየተከናወኑ ነው።
oromo: Ajajni giddugaleessa Ameerikaa naannichatti sochiin galaanaa akka to'atamuuf ergaa dabalata kennee jira. Humnoonni waraanaa hanga ammaatti dooniiwwan daldalaa 35 ta'an karaa isaanii akka jijjiiran kan godhan yoo ta'u, dooniiwwan lama to'annoo jala oolchanii lama immoo akka hin sochoone godhaniiru. Hojiin to'annoo kunis xiyyaarota waraanaa USS Abrahaam Linkoln irraa ka'an gargaarsifachuun kan gaggeeffamaa jiru dha.

title: Iran says Hormuz talks with Oman in final stages
english: Iran and Oman are nearing a final agreement regarding maritime operations in the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian officials confirmed that the discussions focus on establishing a shared framework for managing the waterway. They emphasized that this deal is about setting up a specific route and does not change the operational status of the strait itself.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ ላይ የንግድ እና የአሰሳ ስምምነት ለማድረግ የመጨረሻው ምዕራፍ ላይ ደርሰዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት፣ ንግግሮቹ በወሽመጡ አጠቃቀም ላይ የጋራ መግባባት ለመፍጠር ያለሙ ናቸው። ይህ ስምምነት አዳዲስ መስመሮችን የሚመለከት እንጂ የወሽመጡን የመዝጋት ወይም የመክፈት አቋም እንደማይቀይር ተብራርቷል።
oromo: Iraanii fi Omaanni bakka markaboonni itti darban kan Hormuz irratti walii galtee xumura irra ga'aniiru. Mootummaan Iraan akka ibsetti, mariin kun karaa kanneen bakka kana fayyadaman gidduutti walii galtee uumuuf kan karoorfame dha. Haata'u malee, qophiin kun karaa haaraa mijeeffachuu qofa malee, daandiin Hormuz akka cufamu ykn banamu kan jijjiiru miti.

title: Gaza death toll rises to at least 18
english: The ongoing Israeli military operations in Gaza have resulted in the deaths of at least 18 people. Among the casualties, four individuals were killed when an airstrike targeted a vehicle in central Gaza City. Tensions remain high as the conflict continues to cause loss of life in the region.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው የእስራኤል ጥቃት የሟቾች ቁጥር ቢያንስ 18 ደርሷል። ከሟቾቹ መካከል አራቱ የተገደሉት በመካከለኛው ጋዛ ከተማ በአንድ መኪና ላይ በተሰነዘረ የአየር ጥቃት ነው። በክልሉ እየተባባሰ ያለው ግጭት ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት እየቀጠፈ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hojiin waraanaa Israa'el gara Gazaatti gaggeessaa jirtuun lubbuun namoota 18 ol darbeera. Namoota du'an keessaa afur kanneen ta'an, magaalaa Gaza giddu galeessaatti konkolaataa tokko irratti xiyyaaraan haleellaa erga raawwatamee booda lubbuun isaanii darbe. Walitti bu'iinsi naannicha keessatti jiru lubbuu namootaa baayyee galaafachuu itti fufeera.

title: Fetus found among the ruins of a deadly Israeli strike on Gaza
english: A deadly Israeli airstrike in western Gaza City resulted in the deaths of a pregnant woman, her husband, and their young son. While searching through the building's wreckage, local residents discovered the body of the woman's unborn baby. This tragedy highlights the devastating human toll of the ongoing conflict on Palestinian families.
amharic: በምዕራብ ጋዛ ከተማ በተፈጸመ ገዳይ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት አንዲት ነፍሰ ጡር ሴት፣ ባለቤታቸው እና የአምስት ዓመት ልጃቸው ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች የፈራረሰውን ህንጻ ፍርስራሽ ሲያፈራርሱ ያልተወለደውን ህጻን አስክሬን አግኝተዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በግጭቱ ሳቢያ በቤተሰቦች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን ከባድ ጉዳት ያሳያል።
oromo: Magala Gaza lixaatti weerara xiyyaaraa Israa'elin gaggeeffameen dubartii ulfa tokko, abbaa manaa ishee fi ilma isaanii waggaa shan ta'e dabalatee maatiin guutuun lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Jiraattonni iddoo sana gadi jedhanii yeroo qoratanitti reeffa mucaa dhalachuu hin dandeenye argataniiru. Balaan kun miidhaa hamaa walitti bu'iinsi kun maatiiwwan Falasxiin irraan gahaa jiru agarsiisa.

title: Migrant deaths in Ceuta rise to 72 after border surge from Morocco
english: At least 72 people have died after an unprecedented wave of approximately 60,000 migrants crossed from Morocco into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. While many have since returned to Morocco, the massive surge has caused a significant regional crisis, leading to new border security measures and increased pressure on Spanish authorities. Officials warn that the death toll will likely rise as forensic teams continue to identify victims who drowned or were crushed during the crossing.
amharic: ከሞሮኮ ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ በደረሰው ከፍተኛ የስደተኞች የጅምላ መግባት ሳቢያ ቢያንስ 72 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ምንም እንኳን አብዛኞቹ ስደተኞች ወደ ሞሮኮ የተመለሱ ቢሆንም፣ ይህ ያልተጠበቀ ክስተት በክልሉ ትልቅ ቀውስ በመፍጠሩ ስፔን ጥብቅ የድንበር ደህንነት እርምጃዎችን እንድትወስድ አስገድዷታል። የፎረንሲክ ባለሙያዎች ሰለባዎችን መለየታቸውን የቀጠሉ ሲሆን፣ የሟቾች ቁጥር ከዚህም በላይ ሊጨምር እንደሚችል ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Godina Si’uuta (Ceuta) kan Ispeen keessatti godaantotni gara 60,000 ta’an Morookoo irraa seenuun isaanii hordofee lubbuun namoota 72 ol darbeera. Godaantotni kunneen keessaa hedduun gara Morookoo kan deebi’an ta’us, yeroodhuma sanatti mudannoon kun rakkoo guddaa uumeera. Ispeen daangaa ishee tiksuuf tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachaa jirti; gareewwan ogeeyyiis namoota galaana keessatti dhuman adda baasuu itti fufaniiru, lakkoofsi namoota du’anii gara fuulduraatti dabaluu akka malu himameera.

title: ‘Iran war participation trophy’ mocking Trump appears in New York
english: A large, ten-foot-tall golden statue has been displayed in New York's Foley Square as a form of political satire. Created by an anonymous group called Secret Handshake, the artwork mocks Donald Trump for his perceived role in the conflict with Iran. The installation serves as a provocative public statement regarding the former president's involvement in regional military tensions.
amharic: በኒውዮርክ ፎሊ አደባባይ ላይ የቀድሞውን ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕን የሚተች አስር ጫማ ቁመት ያለው የወርቅ ምስል ታይቷል። ምስሉን የፈጠረው 'ሴክሬት ሃንድሼክ' የተሰኘ ማንነቱ ያልታወቀ የኪነ ጥበብ ቡድን ሲሆን፣ ትራምፕ ከአይራን ጋር በተፈጠረው ግጭት ያላቸውን ተሳትፎ ለመተቸት ታስቦ የተሰራ ነው። ይህ የመታሰቢያ ሐውልት በፕሬዝዳንቱ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ላይ የሚሰነዘር የፖለቲካ ትችት መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Magala New York, naannoo Foley Square jedhamutti, fakkii warqee irraa hojjetamee fi dheerina miila kudhan qabu kan Donald Traamp irratti qajeelfame tokko ifatti mul'ateera. Fakkicha kan hojjetan garee 'Secret Handshake' jedhamu kan maqaan isaanii hin beekamne yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas Traamp waraana Iraan keessatti hirmaannaa qabu jedhame irratti qeeqaa dhiyeessuudha. Fakkichi kun ilaalcha siyaasaa fi gahee inni waraana naannichaa keessatti qaba jedhame irratti qeeqaa uumame mul'isa.

title: Deadly floods and landslide hit India’s Kerala
english: Heavy rainfall in India's Kerala state has caused fatal flooding and a dangerous landslide. At least two people have died and eight others were injured in the disaster. While emergency teams have successfully rescued over 500 individuals, authorities are warning that more rain is expected soon.
amharic: በህንድ የኬረላ ግዛት በጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ ሳቢያ ጎርፍ እና የመሬት መንሸራተት አደጋ ተከስቷል። በአደጋው ቢያንስ ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው ያለፈ ሲሆን ስምንት ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ከ500 በላይ የሚሆኑ ነዋሪዎች በአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ታድገዋል፤ ይሁን እንጂ የየአየር ንብረት ባለሙያዎች ተጨማሪ ዝናብ ሊኖር እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Mootummaa Keerala kan Hindii keessatti rooba cimaan hordofee lolaa fi lafti sigiguun lubbuun namoota lamaa darbeera, namoonni saddeetis miidhamaniiru. Tajaajilli gargaarsa hatattamaa namoota 500 ol ta'an lubbuun kan oolchan yoo ta'u, ogeeyyonni qilleensaa garuu roobni daran cimaan itti fufuu akka danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Suicide bomber kills 14 outside police station in Pakistan’s Swat
english: A suicide bomber detonated explosives outside a police station in Pakistan’s Swat Valley, killing at least 14 people and injuring over 20 others. The attack occurred during a protest organized by local residents to demand government intervention against rising regional violence. Security forces have launched an investigation into the incident, which follows a recent spike in militant attacks across the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province.
amharic: በፓኪስታን ስዋት ቫሊ በሚገኝ ፖሊስ ጣቢያ ውጭ በተፈጸመ የራስን ህይወት የማጥፋት የቦምብ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ሲገደሉ ከ20 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን ግጭት በመቃወም ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ በሚያደርጉ ሰዎች መሃል ነው። ባለስልጣናት በአካባቢው ላይ የጸጥታ ቁጥጥር በማድረግ ምርመራ የጀመሩ ሲሆን ጥቃቱ በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የሽብር ተግባር አካል እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Godina Swat kan biyya Paakistaanitti, buufata poolisii tokko duuba qindeeffamee haleellaa of ajjeechuu qaqqabeen namoonni 14 du'anii fi 20 ol ta'an ammoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame uummanni naannichaa, dabalaa dhufe harka namaa fi walitti bu'iinsa mormuuf hiriira bahanii jiran gidduutti. Humnoonni nageenyaa haleellaa kana qorachuu jalqabanii jiran; haleellaan kunis mudannoo weerara fiixee gadhee naannicha keessatti dabalaa dhufuu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Capital One cites anti-money laundering concerns in Trump Organization case
english: Capital One has requested the dismissal of a lawsuit filed by the Trump Organization regarding the 2021 closure of over 300 bank accounts. The bank maintains that these accounts were shut down following a thorough internal review by its anti-money laundering team, rather than for political reasons. While the bank clarified that this is not an accusation of illegal activity, it asserts that the closures were strictly compliant with regulatory guidelines and company policy.
amharic: ካፒታል ዋን ባንክ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2021 ከ300 በላይ የትራምፕ ኦርጋናይዜሽን የባንክ ሂሳቦችን የዘጋው በፖለቲካዊ ምክንያት ሳይሆን በውስጥ የገንዘብ ማጠቢያ መከላከል ቡድን በተደረገ ጥናት መሆኑን ገልጿል። የትራምፕ ድርጅት ሂሳቦቹ የተዘጉት በፖለቲካዊ አድልዎ ነው በማለት ክስ ቢመሰርትም፣ ባንኩ ይህ ውሳኔ የቁጥጥር መመሪያዎችን እና የባንኩን ህግ የተከተለ እንደሆነ አስታውቋል። በዚህም ምክንያት ባንኩ የትራምፕ ኦርጋናይዜሽን ያቀረበው ክስ ውድቅ እንዲደረግለት ለፍርድ ቤት ጥያቄ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Baankiin Kaapital Waan (Capital One) bara 2021 kaayyoo siyaasaatiin osoo hin taane, garee isaanii kan dhimma seeraan alaa maallaqa aduu (anti-money laundering) to'atuun qorannoo erga gaggeessanii booda, akkaawuntota dhaabbata Tirampii 300 ol cufuusaanii ibse. Dhaabbanni Tirampii murtin kun kan fudhatame dhiibbaa siyaasaatiin jechuun himannaa dhiyeesseera. Haa ta'u malee, baankiin kun himannaan kun bu'uura kan hin qabneefi cufaan akkaawuntichaa qajeelfama baankichaa fi seera biyyattii kan hordofee ta'uu ibsuun, himannaan sun akka irra deebiin gatamuu gaafateera.

title: Ukraine says major Russian oil refinery and airfield hit, as Moscow reports eight deaths
english: Ukraine launched long-range drone strikes on key Russian infrastructure, including an oil refinery and a major strategic airfield, causing significant damage. Moscow reported eight fatalities from these attacks and retaliated by targeting Ukrainian port facilities and a postal terminal. These intensified cross-border strikes occur as the conflict remains largely stagnant despite ongoing global efforts to reach a resolution.
amharic: ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ውስጥ በሚገኙ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች እና ወታደራዊ የአየር ማረፊያዎች ላይ በድሮን ጥቃት አደረሰች። ሞስኮ የደረሰባትን ጥቃት ተከትሎ ስምንት ሰዎች መሞታቸውን የገለጸች ሲሆን በምላሹም በዩክሬን ወደቦች እና መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽማለች። የጦርነቱ ግንባር ምንም ለውጥ ባላሳየበት በዚህ ወቅት ሁለቱም ወገኖች በየክልላቸው የሚገኙ የኢነርጂ እና ወታደራዊ ማዕከላትን ማጥቃታቸውን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Yuukireen naannoolee Raashiyaa keessatti bakkeewwan xumura boba'aa fi buufata xiyyaaraa waraanaa gurguddaa irratti haleellaa xiyyaara koo-kon-trolii (drone) raawwatteetti. Raashiyaan haleellaa kanaan namoonni saddeet du'uu isaa gabaastee, deebisus buufataalee bidiruu fi bakkeewwan Yuukireen irratti haleellaa geessiseetti. Garaagarummaan waraanaa gama kanaan jijjiirama dhabus, gareen lamaanuu xiyyeeffannoo isaanii buufataalee anniisaa fi waraanaa irratti godhachaa jiru.

title: Saudi Crown Prince MBS urges Trump to ‘prioritise dialogue’ in US-Iran war
english: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has called on President Donald Trump to choose diplomacy over military action to de-escalate the ongoing conflict with Iran. Following this discussion, President Trump suspended planned strikes, citing progress toward a potential deal aimed at resolving the war. While the US claims an agreement is in the works, Iranian officials have rejected these assertions and remain prepared for further hostilities.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያው አልጋ ወራሽ መሀመድ ቢን ሳልማን ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአሜሪካ-ኢራን ግጭት ጋር በተያያዘ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ከመውሰድ ይልቅ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ችግሩን እንዲፈቱ አሳስበዋል። ከዚህ ውይይት በኋላ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የነበሩትን የታቀዱ ጥቃቶች ለጊዜው አቋርጠዋል። አሜሪካ በስምምነት ላይ መድረሷን ብትገልጽም፣ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ግን ይህን ውሸት ነው በማለት እና ለጦርነት ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ውድቅ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Abbaan taayitaa biyya Saudi Arabia Mohammed bin Salman, pirezidaant Donald Trump waliin mari'achuun walitti bu'iinsa Iran waliin jiru furuuf mala dipiloomaasiin akka fayyadaman gorsaniiru. Marii kana booda, pirezidaant Trump haleellaa qophaa'ee ture dhaabaniiru; kunis waraana kana xumuruuf waliigaltee tokko irra gahuuf akka ta'e ibsameera. Itoophiyaan waliigalticha mirkaneessite iyyuu, mootummaan Iran garuu oduun kun kijiba akka ta'e fi waraanaaf qophii akka ta'an ibsaniiru.

title: Israeli settlers shoot Palestinian child during farm raid
english: A nine-year-old Palestinian boy was shot in the back by Israeli settlers during an attack on his family's farm near Ramallah. The child was injured while attempting to alert his father about the encroaching group. Security footage recorded the incident, which occurred northeast of Al-Mughayyir.
amharic: ራማላህ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ እርሻ ላይ በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት የዘጠኝ ዓመት የፍልስጤም ልጅ በጥይት ተመቷል። ህጻኑ አባቱን ስለ ሰፋሪዎቹ መምጣት ለማስጠንቀቅ ሲሞክር ነበር ጉዳቱ የደረሰበት። ክስተቱ በአካባቢው በነበረ የደህንነት ካሜራ የተቀረጸ ሲሆን፣ ህጻኑ በአል-ሙጋዪር ሰሜናዊ ምስራቅ አቅጣጫ ነበር የተጠቃው።
oromo: Naannoo Raamaalaa, qonna maatii isaa irratti haleellaa raawwatameen mucaan waggaa sagalii kan ta'e dargaggeessi Palastinii tokko waraana Israa'eliin dugda irraa rasaasaan rukutame. Mucichi kan miidhame abbaa isaa garee haleellaa sanaa akeekkachiisuuf yaalii gochaa osoo jiruu dha. Gochi kun kaameeraa nageenyaatiin kan waraabame yoo ta'u, miidhaan kunis gammoojjii Al-Mughayyir irraa gara kaaba-bahaatti kan raawwatame dha.

title: How to end the ‘Hormuz war’
english: The ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran has stalled, with neither side showing signs of yielding after months of military engagement. Iran’s closure of the Strait of Hormuz has triggered a global economic crisis, forcing the U.S. to prioritize reopening the vital shipping lane over its original nuclear objectives. Analysts suggest the most viable path forward is for the U.S. to seek a diplomatic solution rather than continuing a military campaign it cannot sustain.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት ለወራት ቢቀጥልም ሁለቱም ወገኖች እጅ አልሰጡም። ኢራን የሆርሙዝን የባህር በር መዝጋቷ ዓለም አቀፍ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ በመፍጠሯ፣ አሜሪካ ከመጀመሪያው የኑክሌር ግቧ ይልቅ የባህር መንገዱን መልሶ ለመክፈት ቅድሚያ እንድትሰጥ አስገድዷታል። በመሆኑም አሜሪካ ከወታደራዊ እርምጃ ይልቅ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄዎችን መፈለጓ የተሻለ አማራጭ እንደሆነ እየተነገረ ነው።
oromo: Waraanni biyyoota Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru bu'aa tokko malee itti fufeera. Iraan daandii galaana Hormuz cufuun ishee rakkoo diinagdee addunyaa waan uumeef, Ameerikaan galii ishee inni duraa kan niukleeraa ta'e dhiistee karaa kana banuuf dirqamtee jirti. Kanaafuu, Ameerikaan waraana itti fufuu mannaa furmaata quunnamtii biyyoota gidduutti filachuun akka irra jiraatu ibsameera.

title: Ethiopia’s National Dialogue Could Unravel the Federal Bargain
english: Ethiopia has launched a National Dialogue aimed at addressing long-standing political tensions, but many in the Somali Region are concerned about its true purpose. There is a deep fear that the process might be used to weaken the current federal system and the constitutional rights that protect regional self-determination. While Somalis acknowledge that federalism has not always worked well in practice, they view these constitutional safeguards as vital protections against central government overreach and marginalization.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ለመፍታት ያለመ ብሔራዊ ምክክር ጀምራለች፤ ነገር ግን በሶማሌ ክልል ያሉ ብዙ ሰዎች ስለ ሂደቱ ዓላማ ስጋት አላቸው። ይህ ውይይት የፌዴራል ስርዓቱን ለማዳከም እና የክልሎችን ራስን በራስ የማስተዳደር መብት የሚጠብቀውን ህገ-መንግስት ለመቀየር ሊያገለግል ይችላል የሚል ስጋት አለ። የሶማሌ ክልል ነዋሪዎች ፌዴራሊዝም በተግባር ብዙ ጉድለቶች እንዳሉት ቢስማሙም፣ ህገ-መንግስታዊ ዋስትናዎቹ በማዕከላዊ መንግስት ከሚደርስባቸው ተጽዕኖ ለመከላከል ወሳኝ እንደሆኑ ያምናሉ።
oromo: Itoophiyaan rakkoo siyaasaa waggoota dheeraaf turan furuuf marii biyyaalessaa eegalteetti; ta’us, namoonni naannoo Somaalee keessa jiran baay’een mariin kun maal akka fiduuf deemu irratti yaaddoo qabu. Mariin kun sirna federaalizimii fi mirga ofiin of bulchuu naannoolee kan eegu buuura seeraa laaffisuuf itti fayyadamaa ta’uu danda’a jedhanii shakkan. Ummanni Somaalee federaalizimiin hojiirra oolmaa isaa irratti hanqina akka qabu kan amanan ta’us, seeronni bu’uuraa kunneen giddugaleessummaa fi cunqursaa irraa isaan eeguuf waan gargaaranif iddoo guddaa kennuuf.

title: Helicopters fighting Greece wildfires collide in mid-air
english: Two helicopters helping to extinguish wildfires in Greece crashed into each other mid-air and plummeted into a ravine. All four crew members on board survived the accident, though some sustained injuries and required hospitalization. The incident occurred during a difficult period as firefighters struggle to manage widespread blazes intensified by extreme weather and high winds across the country.
amharic: በግሪክ የደን ቃጠሎን ለማጥፋት ሲረዱ የነበሩ ሁለት ሄሊኮፕተሮች በአየር ላይ ተጋጭተው ወደ ገደል ወድቀዋል። አደጋው ቢደርስም በሄሊኮፕተሮቹ ውስጥ የነበሩ አራቱም የበረራ አባላት በህይወት ተርፈዋል፣ ነገር ግን ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው ለህክምና ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል። ክስተቱ የተፈጠረው ሀገሪቱ በጠንካራ ንፋስ እና በከፍተኛ ሙቀት ምክንያት በተቀሰቀሱ ሰፊ የደን ቃጠሎዎች ስትታመስ በነበረበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Giriikitti ibidda bosonaa dhaamsuuf balali'aa turan heelikopteroonni lama qilleensa keessatti walitti bu'uun gara boollaatti kufuunsaanii gabaasameera. Balaa kana keessatti namoonni afur balali'aa turan hundi lubbuun hafanis, miidhaan irra ga'ee wal'aansa fayyaa argachaa jiru. Balaan kun kan mudate yeroo biyyattiin qilleensa cimaafi ho'a guddaan wal qabatee ibidda babal'ate dhaamsuuf carraaqaa jirtetti.

title: At least eight killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza after Hamas agree disarmament deal
english: At least eight people, including families, were killed following overnight Israeli airstrikes on residential areas in Gaza. The attacks occurred shortly after Hamas agreed to a disarmament plan overseen by a U.S.-led peace board. While the IDF maintains they are targeting militants, Israeli officials remain skeptical of the deal and continue to push for greater control over the territory.
amharic: በጋዛ በተፈጸመው የአየር ድብደባ ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ቢያንስ ስምንት ሰዎች መገደላቸው ተነግሯል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው ሀማስ በአሜሪካ መሪነት የቀረበውን ትጥቅ የመፍታት እቅድ ከተቀበለ ቀናት በኋላ ነው። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ኢላማው ታጣቂዎች እንደሆነ ቢገልጽም፣ የእስራኤል መንግስት በሀማስ ትጥቅ የመፍታት እቅድ ላይ ጥርጣሬ አላቸው።
oromo: Halkan darbetti qilleensaan haleellaa Israa'el Gizaatti geggeeffameen ijoollee dabalatee namoonni saddeet ol ta'an du'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame erga gareen Hamas mala meeshaa waraanaa hiikuu kan biyya Ameerikaan durfamu fudhatee guyyoota muraasa booda. Waraanni Israa'el haleellaan kun garee waraanaa irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu ibsus, mootummaan Israa'el garuu karoora meeshaa hiikkannoo Hamas kana irratti shakkiin jiraachuusaa himu.

title: Ukrainian farmers use temporary storage to revive grain exports
english: Ukrainian farmers are turning to temporary storage solutions to manage their grain harvests as Russian military actions continue to block traditional Black Sea export routes. These logistical adjustments are necessary to maintain the flow of agricultural goods despite significantly higher transportation expenses. By improvising these storage methods, producers aim to sustain their operations and mitigate the impact of the ongoing conflict on the global food supply.
amharic: የዩክሬን አርሶ አደሮች የሩሲያ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች የባህር ላይ የወጪ ንግድ መስመሮችን በመዝጋታቸው ምክንያት እህል ለማከማቸት ጊዜያዊ አማራጮችን እየተጠቀሙ ነው። ይህ የሎጂስቲክስ ለውጥ የትራንስፖርት ወጪዎች ቢጨምሩም የእህል ንግድን ለማስቀጠል ወሳኝ ሆኗል። አርሶ አደሮቹ እነዚህን ጊዜያዊ የማከማቻ ዘዴዎች በመጠቀም ምርታቸውን ለገበያ ለማቅረብ እና በዓለም አቀፍ የምግብ አቅርቦት ላይ የጦርነቱን ተፅእኖ ለመቀነስ እየጣሩ ነው።
oromo: Qonnaan bultoonni Yukreen tarkaanfii waraana Raashiyaan karaaleen gurguddaan ergaa midhaanii cufamuu isaatiin walqabatee, midhaan isaanii kuusuuf mala yeroo fayyadamaa jiru. Jijjiirraan kun baasii geejjibaa dabalee iyyuu, oomisha midhaanii gabaaf dhiyeessuuf dirqama ta'eera. Qonnaan bultoonni kun mala kuusaa yeroo kana fayyadamuun, hojiin isaanii akka hin dhaabanne fi dhiibbaan waraana kun dhiyeessii midhaan addunyaarratti qabu hir'isuuf tattaaffii gochaa jiru.

title: Heatwave forces nuclear shutdown in Hungary
english: Hungary has been forced to shut down its primary nuclear power facility due to an intense heatwave. Extremely high temperatures and drought conditions have lowered the Danube River, which is essential for cooling the plant's reactors. This is the first time in over four decades that the facility has had to halt operations for this reason.
amharic: ሃንጋሪ በከባድ የሙቀት መጠን ምክንያት ዋና የኒውክሌር ኃይል ማመንጫ ጣቢያዋን ለመዝጋት ተገዳለች። ከፍተኛ ሙቀትና ድርቅ የዳኑቤ ወንዝ የውሃ መጠን እንዲቀንስ በማድረጉ ለጣቢያው ማቀዝቀዣ የሚሆን በቂ ውሃ ማግኘት አልተቻለም። ይህ በ44 ዓመታት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የተከሰተ መስተጓጎል ነው።
oromo: Hangaariin hoo'a cimaa mudateen walqabatee buufata anniisaa niwukilaraa guddaa biyyattii cufuuf dirqamteetti. Hoo'i cimaa fi gogiinsi lagni Daayubii hanga akka hir'atu waan godheef, raakteroota buufatichaaf qabbaneessituu ta'ee kan tajaajilu bishaan qu'achuu dhabameera. Kunis waggoota 44 keessatti yeroo jalqabaatiif kan mudate ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Tanks, troops and space
english: European Defence Commissioner Andrius Kubilius is calling for a major increase in military spending to prepare Europe for potential Russian aggression by 2030. He emphasizes that modern warfare now requires a shift toward satellites, drones, and space technology alongside traditional military assets. Ultimately, Kubilius argues that Europe must achieve greater self-reliance in its defense capabilities to ensure long-term stability and peace.
amharic: የአውሮፓ የመከላከያ ኮሚሽነር አንድሪየስ ኩቢሊየስ አውሮፓ እስከ 2030 ድረስ ሊከሰት ከሚችል የሩሲያ ጥቃት ለመከላከል የመከላከያ በጀቷን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንድትጨምር ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። በዘመናዊው ጦርነት ውስጥ እንደ ታንኮች እና ወታደሮች ሁሉ የጠፈር ቴክኖሎጂ፣ ድሮኖች እና ሳተላይቶች ወሳኝ ሚና እንዳላቸው አስታውቀዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት አውሮፓ ሰላሟን ለማስጠበቅ በራሷ የመከላከያ አቅም መተማመን እንዳለባት አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Komishinarri Ittisa Awurooppaa Andrius Kubilius, Awurooppaan weerara Raashiyaa bara 2030 dura mudachuu danda'uuf jecha baajata ittisaa ishee guddisuu akka qabdu akeekkachiisaniiru. Waraana ammayyaa keessatti gargaarsa waraanaa aadaa akkasumas teeknoolojii sarartoota (satellites), droonotaa fi iddoo bal'aa (space) fayyadamuu akka barbaachisu ibsaniiru. Kanaafuu, nageenya isaanii eeggachuuf Awurooppaan of danda'uu fi dandeettii ittisa ishee cimsuu akka qabdu ibsaniiru.

title: CIA whistleblower John Kiriakou on accountability and CIA’s history
english: Former CIA officer John Kiriakou joined Al Jazeera's UpFront to discuss his past decision to expose the agency's use of waterboarding. Kiriakou remains the only individual who served prison time regarding the controversial interrogation program. During the interview, he analyzed the ongoing issues of secrecy, intelligence practices, and the lack of accountability within the US government.
amharic: የቀድሞው የሲአይኤ ወኪል ጆን ኪሪያኩ የኤጀንሲውን የውሃ ማሰቃየት ድርጊት ይፋ በማድረጋቸው ተቀባይነት ያገኙትን ሂደትና ተያያዥ ጉዳዮችን በአልጀዚራ ውይይት አድርገዋል። በዚሁ ፕሮግራም ምክንያት እስር ቤት የገቡ ብቸኛው ግለሰብ እርሳቸው ናቸው። በቃለ መጠይቁም ወቅት በአሜሪካ የስለላ ተቋማት ውስጥ ያለው የምስጢር አጠባበቅ፣ የሥራ አፈጻጸም እና የተጠያቂነት ክፍተቶች ላይ ሰፊ ማብራሪያ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Hojjetaan duraanii CIA John Kiriakou, waa'ee gocha qaamaa 'waterboarding' jedhamu kan inni ifa baasee fi dhimma itti gaafatamummaa irratti qophii 'UpFront' irratti mari'ateera. Inni sagantaa kana irratti hirmaachuun isaa mana hidhaa akka seenu isa godhe, akkasumas kanaan walqabatee namni hidhame isuma qofa. Maree isaa kanaanis, sirna icitii fi hanqina itti gaafatamummaa mootummaa Amerikaa keessa jiru irratti xiyyeeffateera.

title: Greek firefighting helicopters in mid-air collision, four crew missing
english: Two firefighting helicopters collided in mid-air while battling severe wildfires near Athens, Greece, leaving four crew members missing. The accident occurred as the country struggles with widespread blazes fueled by dry weather and strong winds. Emergency teams are currently conducting a search and rescue operation while hundreds of firefighters work to contain the flames across the region.
amharic: ግሪክ ውስጥ የእሳት አደጋን ለመከላከል ሲንቀሳቀሱ የነበሩ ሁለት ሄሊኮፕተሮች በአየር ላይ ተጋጭተው አራት አብራሪዎች እንደጠፉ ተገልጿል። አደጋው የተከሰተው በግሪክ እየተከሰተ ባለው ከባድ የእሳት ቃጠሎ ሳቢያ ከፍተኛ ጥረት እየተደረገ ባለበት ወቅት ነው። በአሁኑ ሰዓት የፍለጋ እና የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች እየተከናወኑ ሲሆን፣ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ የእሳት አደጋ ሰራተኞችም ተስፋፍቶ ያለውን እሳት ለመቆጣጠር እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Giriikitti helikoptaroonni lama ibidda bosonaa dhaamsuuf balali'aa turan qilleensa keessatti erga walitti bu'anii booda qajeeleewwan afur dhabamaniiru. Balaan kun kan mudate biyyattiin ibidda bosonaa babal'ateen wal qabatee yaaddoo keessa jirtutti dha. Yeroo ammaa kana hojii barbaachaafi baraarsaatu adeemsifamaa jiru, akkasumas dhaabbattoonni tajaajila hatattamaa dhibbaan lakkaa'aman ibidda kana to'achuuf carraaqqii cimaa taasisaa jiru.

title: Opinion: Israel's genocide has frozen a generation of Gaza's young doctors
english: During a sudden evacuation order at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in July 2025, junior doctor Ahmed Shabat was faced with a life-altering decision amidst the chaos of impending bombardment. While others fled for their safety, he discovered an abandoned patient suffering from a severe, life-threatening injury. This incident highlights the harrowing dilemmas faced by young medical professionals working under extreme danger in Gaza.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በጁላይ 2025 በአል-አቅሳ ሰማዕታት ሆስፒታል በተሰጠ ድንገተኛ የለቀቃ ትእዛዝ ወቅት፣ ዶክተር አህመድ ሻባት በቦምብ ጥቃት ስጋት መካከል ከባድ ውሳኔ ገጥሞታል። ሌሎች ለደህንነታቸው ሲሉ ሲሸሹ፣ ዶክተሩ በአጋጣሚ በጠና የቆሰለ እና ተረሳሽ የሆነ ታካሚ አግኝቷል። ይህ ክስተት በጋዛ ውስጥ በከፍተኛ አደጋ ውስጥ የሚሰሩ ወጣት የህክምና ባለሙያዎች የሚጋፈጡትን አስከፊ ፈተና ያሳያል።
oromo: Adoolessa 2025 hospitaala Al-Aqsa Martyrs irratti ajajni gadhiisanii ba'uu kennamee ture, doktarri dargaggeessi Ahmad Shabat gidduu reebicha bombii keessatti murtoo ulfaataa isa mudate. Namoonni biroon lubbuu isaanii oolchuuf yeroo baqatan, doktarichi namicha madaa hamaa qabu kan dagatame argate. Taateen kun rakkoo cimaa fi dhiphuu ogeeyyotni fayyaa dargaggoonni Gaza keessatti keessa darbanii hojjetan kan agarsiisuudha.

title: 'They almost killed my child': Women in Syria's Roj camp describe night of gunfire and fear
english: Kurdish-led forces fired shots into a Syrian refugee camp housing families of suspected Islamic State fighters during a confrontation on Friday. The violence occurred after several days of peaceful protests by women demanding better treatment and repatriation. Although no injuries were reported, residents described the event as a terrifying experience that left many children severely traumatized as bullets pierced through their tents.
amharic: በሶሪያ በሚገኝ የስደተኞች ካምፕ ውስጥ የኩርድ ታጣቂዎች በወሰዱት የኃይል እርምጃ በካምፑ ውስጥ የሚገኙ ሴቶችና ህጻናት ከፍተኛ ፍርሃት ውስጥ መውደቃቸውን ገለጹ። ግጭቱ የተከሰተው ሴቶቹ የተሻለ አያያዝና ወደ ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ በመጠየቅ ላይ ባደረጉት ተቃውሞ ሳቢያ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የሰው ህይወት ባይጠፋም፣ ጥይቶች በድንኳኖች ውስጥ በማለፋቸው በነዋሪዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ የስነ-ልቦና ጉዳት ደርሷል።
oromo: Siriyaa keessatti kampii baqattootaa keessatti waraanni Kirdii dhukaasa banuun dubartootaa fi ijoollee achi keessa jiran rifachiiseera. Walitti buutiin kun kan uumame dubartoonni gaaffii haala gaarii fi gara biyya isaanii deebi'uu dhiheessaa turan irratti hundaayee ti. Namni tokkollee miidhamuu baatus, rasaasni dunkaana keessa darbuun isaa ijoollee fi maatii isaanii irratti miidhaa sammuu cimaa dhaqqabsiiseera.

title: Israeli attacks kill 14 in Gaza on Sunday
english: Israeli military operations across Gaza on Sunday resulted in 14 deaths, including a child. The latest casualties occurred after a strike hit a tent sheltering displaced families in the Remal district. These attacks follow previous bombings in Gaza City, Deir el-Balah, and Khan Younis earlier in the day.
amharic: እሁድ ዕለት በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች በጋዛ ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ሲገደሉ፣ ከሟቾቹ መካከል አንድ ህጻን ይገኝበታል። ጥቃቱ በተለይ በረማል አካባቢ ተፈናቃዮች ተጠልለውበት በነበረው ድንኳን ላይ ያነጣጠረ ነበር። ይህ ክስተት ቀደም ሲል በጋዛ ከተማ፣ በዴይር አል-ባላህ እና በካን ዩኒስ ከተሞች ከተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች በኋላ የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Dilbata darbe weerara waraana Israa'el Gasaa keessatti gaggeesseen lubbuun namoota 14 darbeera; isaan keessaas ijoolleen tokko ni argamu. Ajjeechaan kun kan raawwatame buufata namoonni qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'an keessa jiraatan Remalitti rukutamee dha. Weerara kana dura magaala Gasaa, Deir el-Balah fi Khan Younis keessatti haleellaawwan gurguddoon gaggeeffamanii turan.

title: Communal violence between Hindus and Muslims grips southern Nepal
english: Tensions remain high in southern Nepal following several days of clashes between Hindu and Muslim groups. The conflict was triggered last week by a disagreement involving a traditional Hindu procession in the Sunsari district. Authorities are currently monitoring the situation closely as the violence has left multiple towns in a state of unrest.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ኔፓል በሂንዱ እና በሙስሊም ማህበረሰቦች መካከል በተቀሰቀሰ ግጭት ምክንያት ውጥረቱ እንደቀጠለ ነው። ግጭቱ የተጀመረው ባለፈው ሳምንት በሱንሳሪ አውራጃ በተካሄደ የሂንዱ ሃይማኖታዊ ሰልፍ ላይ በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ነው። ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን በጥብቅ እየተከታተሉ ሲሆን፣ የሁከት ድርጊቶቹ በተለያዩ ከተሞች አለመረጋጋትን ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Naannoo kibba Neepaalitti walitti bu'iinsi gidduu ummata Hinduu fi Musliimaa uumamee guyyoota muraasa erga lakkoofsise booda waraansichi itti fufee jira. Walitti bu'iinsi kun kan jalqabe torban darbe aanaa Sunsarii keessatti ayyaana Hinduu waliin walqabatee wal-hubannoo dhabuu irraayi. Humnoonni nageenyaa haala naannichaa hordofaa jiran yoo ta'u, walitti bu'iinsi kun magaalota hedduu keessatti jeequmsa uumee jira.

title: Hundreds mourn Moroccan footballer who died trying to reach Ceuta
english: A young Moroccan football player named Faten Ben Omar El Azizi has passed away while attempting to cross the sea to reach the Spanish territory of Ceuta. Her family revealed that she tragically died on the very same day her visa for travel was approved. Her death highlights the ongoing dangers faced by many individuals risking their lives to migrate to Europe.
amharic: ፋተን ቤን ኦማር ኤል አዚዚ የተባለች ወጣት ሞሮኳዊት እግር ኳስ ተጫዋች ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ ለመድረስ በባህር ጉዞ ላይ እያለች ህይወቷ አልፏል። ቤተሰቦቿ እንደገለጹት አሳዛኙ ክስተት የደረሰው ለመጓዝ ያመለከተችበት ቪዛ በተፈቀደላት ቀን ነው። ሞቷም ወደ አውሮፓ ለመግባት ህይወታቸውን ለአደጋ የሚያጋልጡ ስደተኞች የሚገጥማቸውን ፈታኝ ሁኔታ ያሳያል።
oromo: Taphattuun kubbaa miilaa dargaggeettiin biyya Morookoo Faten Ben Omar El Azizi, gara naannoo Ispeen kan taate Se'utaatti ce'uuf yaalii goote irratti lubbuun ishee darbeera. Maatiin ishee akka ibsanitti, balaan kun kan isa mudate guyyuma fiizaan ishee itti hayyamame ture. Duuti ishee kun namoota gara Awurooppaa seenuuf jecha lubbuu isaanii balaaf saaxilan kanneen biroo mudatu hundaaf gadda guddaadha.

title: Pakistan-administered Kashmir election boycott follows deadly crackdown
english: Residents of Muzaffarabad in Pakistan-administered Kashmir have launched an election boycott and a general strike. This action follows intense unrest and a violent crackdown that reportedly resulted in at least 80 deaths since June. Protesters are challenging the legitimacy of the voting process given the significant loss of life and instability in the region.
amharic: በፓኪስታን አስተዳደር ስር ባለው ካሽሚር ሙዛፋራባድ ነዋሪዎች ምርጫውን በመቃወም አድማ አድርገዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የተፈፀመው ከሰኔ ወር ጀምሮ በክልሉ በደረሰው ከፍተኛ ብጥብጥና የሃይል እርምጃ ቢያንስ 80 ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን ካጡ በኋላ ነው። ተቃዋሚዎች በክልሉ በነበረው አለመረጋጋትና በሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ምክንያት የምርጫ ሂደቱ ተቀባይነት እንደሌለው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Namoonni magaalaa Muzaffaraabaad, kanneen bulchiinsa Paakistaan jala jiran, sagalee kennuu diduun qilleensa ga’eetti bahaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, ji’a Waxabajjii irraa jalqabee walitti bu’iinsa biyyattii keessatti uumameen lubbuun namoota 80 ol erga darbee booda. Hiriirtonni kun, namoota hedduu lubbuun darbe fi nageenyi waan hin jirreef, adeemsi filannoo kun seera qabeessa miti jechuun mormaa jiru.

title: Yemen’s crumbling roads mean an arduous quest for water for Taiz villagers
english: In Yemen's Taiz governorate, residents of Ragem village are struggling to access basic supplies like water because damaged and unpaved roads prevent transport vehicles from reaching their area. Faced with government inaction and limited aid, local volunteers have started a grassroots project to repair and pave the roads themselves using community donations. While they have made significant progress over the last three years, the group continues to work hard to complete the remaining treacherous sections of the route.
amharic: በየመን ታኢዝ ግዛት የሚገኙ የራጌም መንደር ነዋሪዎች የመንገድ መሰረተ ልማት መበላሸት ምክንያት እንደ ውሃ ያሉ መሰረታዊ ፍላጎቶችን ለማግኘት ከፍተኛ ችግር ላይ ናቸው። መንግስት መፍትሄ ባለመስጠቱ እና እርዳታ ባለመገኘቱ፣ የሀገር ውስጥ በጎ ፈቃደኞች በራሳቸው የገንዘብ ማሰባሰቢያ ዘዴዎች መንገዶችን ለመጠገን እና ለማደስ ተንቀሳቅሰዋል። ላለፉት ሶስት ዓመታት የጀመሩት ይህ የህዝብ ተሳትፎ ስራ ብዙ ውጤት ያስመዘገበ ቢሆንም፣ አሁንም ቀሪ አስቸጋሪ የመንገድ ክፍሎችን ለመጨረስ ጥረታቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Godina Ta'iz kan Yaman keessatti, jiraattonni baadiyyaa Ragem daandiin manca'uu isaa irraa kan ka'e bishaan dabalatee meeshaalee barbaachisoo argachuuf rakkachaa jiru. Mootummaan furmaata waaraa dhabuu fi gargaarsi dhabamuu isaa hordofee, dargaggoonni naannichaa ofii isaanii ijaarsa daandichaa irratti qindoominaan hojjechaa jiru. Waggoota sadan darban keessatti bu'aa gaarii galmeessanis, hamma ammaatti kutaa daandichaa kan hafe xumuruuf carraaqqii cimaa taasisaa jiru.

title: South Korea has hottest day on record amid extreme weather globally
english: South Korea recently experienced its hottest temperature in over a century, with the city of Yangsan reaching 42.5 degrees Celsius. This record-breaking heat is part of a global pattern of extreme weather events, including wildfires and floods, which experts attribute to human-driven climate change. In response to the dangerous conditions, authorities have issued emergency heat alerts across the country as the frequency of such intense heatwaves continues to rise.
amharic: ደቡብ ኮሪያ ከዘጠና ዓመታት በላይ በታሪክ ታይቶ በማይታወቅ መልኩ ከፍተኛ ሙቀት ተመዝግቦባታል፣ የያንግሳን ከተማም 42.5 ዲግሪ ሴንቲግሬድ ደርሳለች። ይህ አስደንጋጭ የሙቀት መጠን በዓለም ዙሪያ እየተከሰቱ ካሉ የእሳት ቃጠሎዎች እና ጎርፍ የመሳሰሉ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ መዘዞች አንዱ ነው። የሙቀት መጠኑ ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ፣ ባለሥልጣናቱ በሀገሪቱ የድንገተኛ ጊዜ ማስጠንቀቂያዎችን አስተላልፈዋል።
oromo: Koree Kibbaa keessatti ho’i qilleensaa jaarraa tokko keessatti raajii ta’e galmaa’ee jira; magaalattiin Yangsaan digrii Seelsiyesii 42.5 ga’ee jira. Ho’i kun addunyaa guututti balaa ibiddaa fi lolaan walqabatee mudachaa jiru keessaa isa tokko yoo ta’u, ogeeyyiin jijjiiramni qilleensaa dhala namaatiin dhufuudha jedhu. Haala sodaachisaa kana hordofee, mootummaan biyyattii akeekkachiisa hatattamaa labsuun ummataaf qajeelfama kennee jira.

title: Israel's genocide has frozen a generation of Gaza's young doctors
english: The conflict in Gaza has severely hindered the professional development of young doctors, forcing them to abandon their medical residencies to work as volunteers amidst constant danger. Junior physicians are currently forced to perform complex, life-saving procedures without proper supervision or specialized training due to the collapse of the healthcare system. This stagnation has created a lost generation of medical professionals who are struggling to advance their skills while trying to save lives under extreme conditions.
amharic: በጋዛ ያለው ጦርነት ወጣት ሐኪሞች የሕክምና ትምህርታቸውን አቋርጠው በአደገኛ ሁኔታ ውስጥ በፈቃደኝነት እንዲያገለግሉ በማድረግ የሙያ እድገታቸውን አግዶታል። የጤና ሥርዓቱ በመፍረሱ ምክንያት፣ ወጣት ሐኪሞች ተገቢው ልዩ ሥልጠና ሳይኖራቸው ውስብስብ የሕይወት አድን ሥራዎችን ለመሥራት ተገደዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ የወደፊቱን የጤና ባለሙያዎች ትውልድ የእድገት ጎዳና በመግታት፣ በከባድ ሁኔታዎች ውስጥ ሕይወት ለማትረፍ እንዲታገሉ አድርጓቸዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Gaaza keessatti adeemaa jiru ogeeyyota fayyaa dargaggootaa carraa barnootaa isaanii akka gadi lisan fi haala cimaa keessatti fedhiidhaan akka hojjetan dirqisiiseera. Sirni fayyaa waan diigameef, ogeeyyotni kun leenjii cimaa fi gargaarsa ogeeyyota gurguddoo malee dhibee ulfaataa yaaluuf dirqamanii jiru. Haalli kun dhaloota ogeeyyota fayyaa abdii qaban kana kan gufachiise yoo ta'u, haala ulfaataa keessatti lubbuu namootaa oolchuuf of kennanii hojjechaa jiru.

title: Israeli finance minister calls for settlements near Gaza
english: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich has requested that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu authorize the creation of three new settlements near the Gaza border. Smotrich, who oversees settlement policy, also expressed plans for further expansion in the occupied West Bank. This proposal comes amidst ongoing military operations in the region despite recent ceasefire discussions.
amharic: የእስራኤል የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ቤዛልኤል ስሞትሪች ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በጋዛ ድንበር አቅራቢያ ሶስት አዳዲስ ሰፈራዎችን እንዲያቋቁሙ ጠይቀዋል። ሚኒስትሩ በዌስት ባንክም ተጨማሪ ሰፈራዎችን የመገንባት እቅድ እንዳላቸው ገልጸዋል። ይህ ጥያቄ የመጣው በክልሉ ግጭቶች በቀጠሉበት እና የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቶች ባሉበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Israa'el Bezalel Smotrich, Ministira Mummee Benyamin Netanyaahuun daangaa Gaazaa biratti naannolee qubannaa haaraa sadii akka hundeessan gaafataniiru. Ministirichi naannoo Qilleensa-gamaa (West Bank) keessattis qubannaa dabalataa ijaaruuf karoorfachuu ibsaniiru. Yaanni kun kan dhufe yeroo waraanni naannichatti itti fufee jiru fi waliigalteen dhaabbii waraanaa irratti mariin taasifamaa jiru keessatti dha.

title: Israeli finance minister calls for building settlements near Gaza amid ongoing Israeli offensive
english: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich has formally requested permission from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to build new settlements in northern Gaza. This proposal comes amid ongoing military operations and reports of continued casualties despite a previously announced ceasefire. Additionally, Smotrich plans to expand settlement infrastructure throughout the occupied West Bank.
amharic: የእስራኤል የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ቤዛሌል ስሞትሪች በሰሜናዊ ጋዛ አዳዲስ ሰፈራዎችን ለመገንባት ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ፈቃድ ጠይቀዋል። ይህ ጥያቄ የመጣው ቀደም ሲል ከተገለጸው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት በኋላም ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች እና የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት በሚቀጥሉበት ወቅት ነው። በተጨማሪም ሚኒስትሩ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ተጨማሪ ሰፈራዎችን ለመገንባት እቅድ አላቸው።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Israa'el Bezalel Smotrich kaaba Gaazaatti qubattoota haaraa ijaaruuf muummee ministeeraa Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuuf gaaffii dhiyeesseera. Gaaffiin kun kan dhufe waraanni fi miidhaan namarra gahuu walii galtee tasgabii erga labsamee boodas itti fufaa jiraachuun ibsamee utuu jiruu dha. Kana malees, ministirichi lafa waraanaan qabamee jiru kan Weest Baank keessatti qubattoota babal'isuuf karoorfatee jira.
